title: Recruiter – LATAM (Remote)
description:
GrowthAssistant is looking for an experienced Recruiter for LATAM to join our growing team!


In this role, you’ll manage the end-to-end recruitment process — from creating job postings to sourcing, screening, interviewing, and closing hires. You’ll work closely with hiring managers to ensure a smooth and efficient hiring experience for candidates and internal teams alike.


As we’re a fast-paced startup , you’ll wear multiple hats and contribute beyond traditional recruitment — from supporting process documentation to working within our CMS. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who’s resourceful, proactive, and eager to learn new things.


What You’ll Do

  • Create and publish job ads across various job boards and social media platforms.
  • Source and network with potential candidates through platforms like LinkedIn, Indeed, Facebook, and OnlineJobs.
  • Collaborate with hiring managers to define qualification criteria and hiring needs.
  • Screen resumes and applications to build strong candidate pipelines.
  • Conduct initial interviews and create shortlists of qualified candidates.
  • Maintain consistent candidate communication throughout the hiring process.
  • Manage and update the candidate database for future opportunities.
  • Support documentation of recruitment processes and best practices as needed.


What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience as a Recruitment Specialist, Recruiter , or similar role.
  • Strong background hiring for Digital Marketing Assistants/Associates or Social Media roles .
  • Proficient in sourcing techniques on social media and professional job sites.
  • Familiarity with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) .
  • Excellent English communication skills — written and spoken.
  • Demonstrated experience handling high-volume recruitment for managerial and executive-level positions.
  • Comfortable working with US-based and off-shore clients .
  • A self-starter who can work independently and figure things out with minimal direction.


Nice to Have

  • Experience working within a startup environment .
  • Exposure to CMS tools or documentation platforms.


Why You’ll Love Working Here

At GrowthAssistant, you’ll collaborate with a diverse, talented team, sharpen your skills with global clients, and make an impact in your career. We value your growth and recognize your contributions every step of the way.


Apply today and take the next step in your career with GrowthAssistant!

title: Assessor de investimentos
description:
Estamos em busca de um/a profissional que acima de tudo tenha atitude e comprometimento com a busca de resultados! 


Você é movido/a por desafios e busca uma oportunidade de alto impacto no mercado financeiro?


Se respondeu sim à pergunta anterior, queremos você para ser um/a profissional para integrar nossa equipe comercial e atuar na comercialização do nosso produto de investimento, um produto financeiro diferenciado, em plena expansão, que vem transformando a experiência de investimento dos clientes e que gera ótima rentabilidade para o investidor e altos ganhos para você. 


Se você tem pensamento empreendedor, gosta de construir relacionamentos e quer crescimento profissional e financeiro, em um ambiente dinâmico, essa vaga é para você!


Atividades


• Trabalhar na captação de recursos para composição de carteira;

• Manutenção e zelo com os clientes captados;

• Atuar no relacionamento e atendimento consultivo, entendendo as necessidades do cliente;

• Apresentar e comercializar o produto de forma clara, transparente e convincente;

• Participar de reuniões, eventos e treinamentos voltados à performance comercial;

• Contribuir ativamente para a expansão e fortalecimento da marca no mercado.



Experiência desejada:


• Vivência anterior em vendas (preferencialmente no setor financeiro, seguros, investimentos ou produtos de alta renda);

• Serâ considerado um diferencial ter passagem em bancos, bancos de investimentos ou como assessor de plataformas de investimentos;

• Habilidade em negociação e fechamento de negócios;

• Boa comunicação verbal e escrita;

• Perfil proativo, resiliente e orientado para resultados;

• Desejável carteira de clientes ativa (será um ótimo diferencial);

• Além das habilidades acima, será um diferencial a formação em Economia, Administração ou áreas correlatas, bem como certificações como CFP ou similar.



Remuneração:


• Nosso modelo de remuneração é integralmente linkado à resultados e é superior ao mercado;

• Modelo competitivo de ganhos;

• Oportunidade de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional;


Você terá também:


• Treinamento completo sobre o produto e suporte para maximizar resultados;

• Atuação em um mercado em expansão, com grande potencial de ganhos;

• Possibilidade de fazer investimentos próprios com rentabilidade muito elevadas e bem acima dos produtos de mercado;



Local de trabalho: home office

Tipo de contrato: a definir conforme perfil do candidato.


Se interessou? Se candidate e venha fazer parte dessa jornada de crescimento conosco.

title: AI Staff Engineer (Remote)
description:
AI Staff EngineerWe are a collective group of fearless people with a clear purpose: to empower professionals around the world through intelligent workflow automation software. Currently, more than 500 people across 7 countries work with us, remotely or in a hybrid way, to make life easier for over 3,000 companies using Pipefy in more than 180 countries. Since our founding in 2015, we have put people at the center of everything we do, so we invite you to learn more about this position and apply to be part of our team.


You’ll be responsible for empowering users to make the productivity revolution happen in their companies.


As an AI Developer at Pipefy, your mission is to leverage AI to solve user problems proactively! It can be programming a new feature, polishing existing features, supporting a team member, giving feedback, or solving a bug. Your role is crucial in driving our AI capabilities forward.


You'll have the opportunity to conduct and participate in experiments, make suggestions to improve our architecture and product and use tons of data to make the best decisions.


Since we are fully remote, you'll meet and work with people from all around the world.


One paragraph resume about what people can expect from working in this position (Mission in the role, responsibilities, seniority and what profile we are looking for).


Main Responsibilities:


- Develop new features from start to finish: through conception, research, implementation, and maintenance, as well as improve existing ones, focusing on AI-driven functionalities.

- Take responsibility for the system quality by driving testability together with architects and QAs to ensure that the way we design our platform enables controllability and automation.

- Take responsibility for system stability, ensuring proper testing and observability, actively monitoring production behavior, and reacting quickly to incidents.

- Share knowledge with the team and learn together. We believe knowledge is much more valuable when shared, so we’re always learning and teaching each other.

- Take part in the continuous improvement of Engineering processes, like recruiting, hiring, onboarding, documentation, incidents, tech talks, etc.

- Sought out for technical guidance on your squad and related ones, anticipate technical issues at the product level, and make architectural and design decisions to avoid them.

- Consistently reduce the complexity of projects, systems, and processes to get more done with less work. Breaks up deliverables to optimize for earlier feedback and incremental delivery of business value.

- Help the team develop a more robust engineering culture focused on quality and impactful deliveries by setting an example and mentorship.

- Identify and proactively create projects to fix Pipefy's architecture when preconditions change and current architecture is not optimal/fit anymore, extracting and documenting platforms whenever necessary.


Requirements:


- Write correct, clean code with periodic guidance; consistently follows best practices, including tests (unit, functional, integration).

- Exceptional proficiency in Python, LLM applications and AI model integration.

- Design and develop code to provide an integrated and managed development life cycle for traditional and generative ML applications.

- Experience using LLM-based frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph and others.

- Experience in implementing RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems and working with vector databases.

- Have practical knowledge about infrastructure, service architectures, tools, libraries, frameworks, continuous integration, and continuous deployment systems.

- Able to seamlessly learn and guide others across large sections of our codebase.

- Actively contributes to the technical design of features.

- Understand and make well-reasoned design tradeoffs in their area.

- Strong ability with RESTful.


Bonus point:


- Experience in fine-tuning pre-trained LLMs.

- Infrastructure: Cloud Computing, AWS, Networks, Load Balancers, Web Servers, Containerization, Docker, Kubernetes, Disaster Recovery, Monitoring.

- Experience with document processing and data extraction pipelines.

- Experience with GraphQL apis.

- You have a sharp eye for UX/UI, and you work user-centered.

- Experience with different types of methodologies and tools for Unit, Integration and End to End testing.

- Have good communication in oral and written English.

- Experience working on agile and lean methodologies.

- Experience building and scaling complex, high-performance, high-transaction applications.


Benefits:


- Health and Dental Plan

- Individual Life Insurance

- Flexible Hours (in compliance with daily work hours)

- Flexible Meal/Food Allowance

- Home Office Support

- Furniture Assistance

- Psychological Support (for you or legal dependents)

- Wellhub

- Extended Maternity and Paternity Leave

- School/Nanny Allowance

- Supplemental Nutrition Assistance

- Veterinary Plan

- Birthday Day Off

- Marriage Leave (7 days)

- Bereavement Leave for Loved Ones (10 days)

- Bereavement Leave for Adoption or Pet Loss (2 days)

- Individual Funeral Assistance

- Monthly Education Support

- Payroll Loan

- Financial Consulting

- Udemy Corporate Access

- Coworking Space

- Pipefy License for up to 10 Users

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
Location: San Francisco, CA - Remote (LATAM preferred)

Work Type: Full-Time


We’re partnering with a confidential, high-growth technology company in Silicon Valley that’s building AI-powered platforms. This team moves fast, cares about craftsmanship, and empowers engineers to own meaningful work for the long term.


This is a full-time, remote opportunity to join a global-first product team tackling complex problems with modern tech and a culture that values quality and speed.


✅ What You’ll Do

- Design, build, and maintain features across the stack.

- Collaborate closely with product, design, and engineering peers to ship high-quality work.

- Write clean, well-tested, well-documented code.

- Contribute to architecture decisions, technical planning, and code reviews.

- Help shape team workflows, best practices, and developer experience.


What You Bring

- 5+ years of professional experience in software development as a Full Stack Developer.

- 2+ years of professional experience as an AI/ML Engineer.

- Proficiency with Python, React, Express, MongoDB, Node or equivalent .

- Strong understanding of APIs, performance, scalability, etc..

- Clear, proactive communication and comfort working on distributed, async teams.

- A product mindset and strong sense of ownership.

- Startup or high-growth team background

- Proficiency in English

- Passion for building scalable systems and great user experiences.


What You’ll Get

- Competitive compensation in USD.

- 100% remote with flexible hours.

- Long-term, product-focused work with clear ownership.

- A smart, collaborative, globally distributed team.


If you’re excited to work with a fast-moving team building the future of AI at scale — let’s connect.

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


Ei Profissional venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!



  • O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


Requisitos técnicos:


Estamos iniciando um grande projeto de conversão do CNPJ para formato alfanumérico , uma iniciativa regulatória obrigatória que todas as empresas deverão executar até meados de 2026 .

O desafio envolve um alto volume de programas e requer atuação técnica sólida em:

  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção COBOL (baixa plataforma)
  • Testes unitários e integrados
  • Documentação técnica
  • Manipulação de arquivos VSAM, sequenciais e JCL
  • Edição e compilação via Microsoft Visual Studio
  • Consultas em Microsoft SQL Server

Também fazem parte do ecossistema:

NeoData Analyes File | NeoBatch Management Job’s | C# | ASP.NET | GIT

♂️ Metodologia: Ágil , com uso de JIRA

title: Senior Principal Software Fullstack UI Developer 100% REMOTE
description:
Title: Senior Principal Software Fullstack UI Developer

Location: Brazil (REMOTE)

Duration: Fulltime


(Product based industry experience MUST HAVE)

About the role

Please note, this team is hiring across all levels and candidates are individually assessed and appropriately leveled based upon their skills and experience.

The Client's Admin Console provides our customers with a single unified view into the Client's Platform, allowing them to fully utilize the rich set of cloud security features Client provides.


What’s in it for you

As a member of the UI engineering team, you will collaborate with backend service teams to develop the user interface for products. You will work on both the frontend as well as the web application backend, working closely with our backend teams on Machine Learning, Threat, DLP, IaaS, API’s and other cool technologies. Depending upon the role you are hired for, you may also work on the REST API Gateway which exposes our REST API’s to customers.


What you will be doing

  • Work in the frontend to implement web applications.
  • Work in the WebUI backend to support web application service features.
  • Develop reusable UI components in AngularJS, Angular2+, Javascript and HTML5/CSS3.
  • Ensure that the Clients web interface works seamlessly in all browsers.
  • Keep abreast of latest technologies and web methodologies which could be used in the product in future.
  • We are looking for highly motivated and talented developers who are self-driven and also a good team player.


Required skills and experience

  • 15+ years of full stack software development experience
  • Expertise in Javascript
  • Experience with HTML5/CSS3 and modern CSS Frameworks and pre-compilers.
  • Experience with modern Javascript frameworks (AngularJS and Angular2+ preferred).
  • Experience with backend languages like PHP, Python, Java or NodeJS.
  • Proficient in Algorithms.
  • Proficient in relational database design.
  • Knowledge of secure web development practices.
  • Working knowledge of git or other version controlling tools.
  • Experience in improving web application performance and testing tools is a big plus.


Education

  • BSCS or equivalent required, MSCS or equivalent strongly preferred

title: Auxiliar Técnico em automação industrial
description:
Descrição do Cargo Estamos buscando um Auxiliar Técnico em Instrumentação Industrial para se juntar à nossa equipe em Abaetetuba/Pa ou Belém, PA. Este cargo envolve a execução de tarefas diárias, como calibração e medição de instrumentos, manutenção preventiva, resolução de problemas e apoio no controle de processos industriais. O profissional será responsável por garantir o bom funcionamento dos instrumentos e equipamentos utilizados na automação e controle dos processos industriais. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e requer disponibilidade para Viajar.
Qualificações
Resolução de Problemas: Será valorizada a capacidade de solucionar problemas técnicos de forma rápida e eficaz.
Instrumentação e Calibração: Ter conhecimentos em instrumentação e calibração de equipamentos industriais.
Manutenção Preventiva: Necessário foco, calma, força de vontade e disposição para se cumprir o planejamento e execução de manutenção preventiva nos equipamentos e instrumentos.
Além das habilidades acima, formação técnica em áreas relacionadas será considerada um diferencial.
Vaga para Faixa etária entre 18 e 26 anos.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
About RealQuant

RealQuant is building the first vertical AI platform for commercial real estate — connecting underwriting, asset management, and reporting into one intelligent end-to-end workflow.


We’re not just another proptech tool — we’re building the infrastructure layer modern deal teams will run on .


Our MVP (Supabase + Clerk + Vercel + React/TypeScript) is nearly complete.


Your mission: finish and harden it, productionize it, and lead our migration to an Azure-native platform as we scale from prototype to enterprise-grade system.


Tech Stack

Monorepo: Web App + Excel Add-in


Frontend

Next.js 15 · React · Tailwind · TypeScript · Office.js Excel Taskpane Add-in


Backend / Workflows

FastAPI (Container Apps) · Azure Durable Functions (orchestration / HITL)


Data Layer

Azure Postgres Flexible (RLS + pgBouncer) · Blob Storage · Azure Cache for Redis


Platform & Infra

API Management (APIM) · Azure Front Door + WAF · Private Endpoints / VNET


Security & Monitoring

Key Vault (Managed Identity) · App Insights / Monitor (traces + cost dashboards)


DevOps & Auth

GitHub Actions CI/CD · Clerk / Entra SSO


What You’ll Build

  • Complete and stabilize the MVP (Supabase → Azure migration).
  • Architect production-ready FastAPI microservices for parsing, ingestion & deal automation.
  • Orchestrate background & human-in-loop flows via Azure Durable Functions .
  • Extend the Excel Add-in for comps, sensitivities, and automated deal outputs (LOIs, pitch decks, summaries, recommended assumptions) .
  • Stand up observability dashboards, rate limits, and private-endpoint networking.
  • Leverage AI-assisted dev tools (Cursor, Claude Code ) to ship 10× faster and document as you go.


Expected Outcomes

  • MVP feature-complete and hardened with test coverage
  • Core data + API services deployed on Azure (Postgres Flexible + Functions)
  • Excel Add-in live with first connected workflow
  • Monitoring, alerts & RLS security verified
  • Average API latency < 300 ms ; background jobs < 10 s E2E


Experience

  • 7 + years full-stack (TypeScript + Python)
  • Deep Azure production experience (Functions, Container Apps, APIM, Key Vault)
  • Strong product sense and UX intuition for data-heavy apps
  • Fintech / PropTech background a plus
  • Fluent English · builder’s mindset · bias toward shipping


Selection Process

  • 90-minute async coding test.
  • Technical interview + repo review.
  • Paid trial sprint (build a real feature).


Compensation & Setup

Hourly Based on Experience: full-time remote, EST overlap, immediate start.


Opportunity to convert to core team role with long-term incentives.


How to Apply

Share your GitHub or portfolio and a short note describing a SaaS product you helped take from prototype to production.

title: Desenvolvedor Sênior/ Tech Lead
description:
Sobre a FourD :

Nosso propósito é apoiar nossos clientes na implementação de produtos financeiros e em melhorias de jornadas. Trabalhamos com NuBank, Banco Next e Natura Pay...


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida com .NET Core / ASP.NET.
  • Domínio de C#, APIs RESTful e padrões como DTOs.
  • Conhecimento em versionamento de APIs (ApiVersioning, rotas versionadas).
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não-relacionais.
  • Domínio em Git e controle de versão.
  • Experiência com integração de APIs, sistemas externos e micro serviços.
  • Boa comunicação e adaptabilidade a diferentes projetos e linguagens.
  • Experiência com autenticação/autorização (JWT, OAuth2)
  • Vivência com testes automatizados (unitários e de integração).
  • Experiência com integração de sistemas e manipulação de dados externos.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com arquitetura limpa (Clean Architecture) e arquitetura hexagonal
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de monitoramento, logging e observabilidade (Serilog, Application Insights, Prometheus, Grafana, Kibana).
  • Familiaridade com mensageria (AWS SQS, AWS SNS, Kafka, RabbitMQ) e padrões como Circuit Breaker e Retry.
  • Experiência com gestão de secrets e configuração segura em ambientes diversos.

description:
Sobre a FourD :

Nosso propósito é apoiar nossos clientes na implementação de produtos financeiros e em melhorias de jornadas. Trabalhamos com NuBank, Banco Next e Natura Pay...


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida com .NET Core / ASP.NET.
  • Domínio de C#, APIs RESTful e padrões como DTOs.
  • Conhecimento em versionamento de APIs (ApiVersioning, rotas versionadas).
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não-relacionais.
  • Domínio em Git e controle de versão.
  • Experiência com integração de APIs, sistemas externos e micro serviços.
  • Boa comunicação e adaptabilidade a diferentes projetos e linguagens.
  • Experiência com autenticação/autorização (JWT, OAuth2)
  • Vivência com testes automatizados (unitários e de integração).
  • Experiência com integração de sistemas e manipulação de dados externos.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com arquitetura limpa (Clean Architecture) e arquitetura hexagonal
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de monitoramento, logging e observabilidade (Serilog, Application Insights, Prometheus, Grafana, Kibana).
  • Familiaridade com mensageria (AWS SQS, AWS SNS, Kafka, RabbitMQ) e padrões como Circuit Breaker e Retry.
  • Experiência com gestão de secrets e configuração segura em ambientes diversos.

title: Senior BackEnd Engineer (Typescript)
description:
We are seeking to bring on board a Senior BackEnd Engineer with a deep understanding of Typescript programming, software development methodologies and the ability to design, develop and maintain complex applications, while also contributing significantly to the technical excellence of the team.


Responsibilities


  • Exceptional problem solving skills to identify and solve complex technical issues efficiently.
  • Collaborates with cross-functional teams to integrate frontend and backend components seamlessly.
  • Communicates effectively with team members, stakeholders and non-technical persons and also collaborates well within a team, sharing knowledge and mentoring junior developers.
  • Shows a strong commitment to learning and staying up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends.

Technology Requirements


  • 6+ years of experience as backend developer.
  • Proficient in Typescript, NestJS and Relational and Non-Relational Databases.
  • 2+ years of experience deploying and running code on AWS Lambda, with hands-
  • on experience using DynamoDB and RDS
  • Strong understanding of clean code principles and separation of concerns
  • Emphasizes the importance of testing, automated testing frameworks and writing unit tests.
  • Can design RESTful APIs, architect software systems (taking into consideration scalability, maintainability and performance).
  • Familiar with design patterns, microservices and other software design principles.
  • Familiar with DevOps practices (CI, CD and deployments pipelines). Utilizes tools like Git, Docker, and Kubernetes for development and deployment.
  • Experience with Python and/or Kotlin Multiplatform is a plus.


Profile Requirements


  • Ability to learn quickly and work independently.
  • Strong project management and interpersonal skills.
  • A team player who enjoys collaborating with others.
  • Experience in frontend development is a plus.

title: Accounting Specialist (Remote from Brazil)
description:
About Us

We’re a Boston-based real estate company seeking a detail-oriented accounting professional fluent in English to support our CFO with bookkeeping, financial reporting, and analysis. This remote role is based in Brazil and requires daily communication in English via Zoom and chat.


Key Responsibilities

  • Create and manage QuickBooks invoices, journal entries, and reconciliations
  • Categorize receipts and expenses; prepare monthly financial reports
  • Maintain spreadsheets for rental and mortgage tracking
  • Assist with budgets, financial models, and investor proposals
  • Provide accurate financial data and support the CFO on accounting projects
  • Manage compliance documentation by reviewing transaction files for accuracy and submitting documents for approval


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of accounting or bookkeeping experience
  • Proficiency in QuickBooks (or other accounting software and willingness to learn)
  • Advanced proficiency in Google Sheets (or Excel and willingness to learn Google Sheets)
  • Fluent English (written and spoken); all work and meetings are in English
  • Detail-oriented, analytical, and comfortable managing multiple priorities
  • Reliable internet connection for Zoom and cloud systems
  • Available Monday–Friday, 9 AM–5 PM Eastern (Boston time zone)


Compensation

  • Full-time, R$7,000/month
  • Remote from Brazil
  • Reports to: Chief Financial Officer (Boston HQ)


How to Apply

Please submit your application through LinkedIn with your resume in English .

Applications that are not in English will not be reviewed...because the reviewer only speaks English. ;)

title: Case Manager (Project Manager)
description:
Job description


U.S. Immigration Law Firm, Law offices of Jacob J Sapochnick is growing and developing law firm in the USA that specializes in business, employment, investment, and family immigration to the USA. The law firm is known for providing its best to the clients by offering creative and strategic legal solutions. We are looking for the new team member, case manager to join our team.


Job Responsibilities:


  • Communicate with client - Client communication and excellent customer service is key at the Law Office of Jacob Sapochnick
  • Serving as primary point of contact for clients , conducting initial meetings with clients, explain immigration process, requirements, providing regular updates on the case.
  • Document Collection - Review and analyze client documents. Assemble cases for filing, prepare and organize exhibits.
  • Ensure that clients understand the strategy and steps of the process and lead status updates calls with clients.
  • Be proactive and raising any issues that might delay the petition and report it to attorney and senior legal specialists.
  • Reviewing documentation provided by clients and make sure that client has been informed about all missing documents in advance.
  • Working closely with senior legal specialists and U.S. attorneys to understand the strategy of the case and make sure it is implemented and making sure that the petition is ready in advance for the mid and final reviews of the attorney and that cases are submitted timely.



Requirements:

· Excellent communication skills, grammar, spelling, and written English composition skills is a must.


· B.A. Degree in Law or English or related studies student or graduate.


· Previous legal or immigration experience preferred.


· High level of accuracy, attention to detail, and excellent proofreading skills.


· Strong organizational skills; ability to work under pressure, work within competing deadlines, and prioritize workload effectively.


· Be comfortable with phone calls and video calls.


· Applicant must have the ability to use MS Excel, MS Outlook, MS Word, MS PowerPoint, Adobe Acrobat Professional.


Compensation: $ - $ / monthly + regular bonuses


Schedule:

  • 8-hour shift,
  • Monday to Friday
  • Remote work or office work

title: Software Engineer Sênior - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas negras
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender       
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar       
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!       

Junte-se a nós!

Conhecimento de ATS/ferramentas de recrutamento

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.



Ei #fera, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq!


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • Missão Atuar como referência técnica em Java/React, liderando decisões arquiteturais e melhores práticas.
  • Responsabilidades Definir Solução, revisar código, orientar devs plenos, propor soluções escaláveis.
  • Experiência Java, React, Arquitetura de Microsserviços, Cloud (AWS), CI/CD.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


  • Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Motion Web Designer
description:
About you:

As a Motion Web Designer, you’ll play a central role in shaping visually compelling and accessible web experiences that balance aesthetics with functionality.


You bring to the team the following competencies:

  • 8+ years of experience in creative or visual design roles, ideally in digital environments.
  • Mastery of Lottie Files and light motion design for icons and interactive elements.
  • Familiarity with Figma for crafting responsive web designs.
  • Experience creating and editing video content for hero sections, homepage banners, or other dynamic assets.
  • Strong understanding of ADA compliance principles for web accessibility:
  • Ability to adapt and recycle pre-approved design elements while maintaining consistency and accessibility.
  • A refined eye for layout, typography, color, and visual hierarchy .
  • Basic understanding of UI and usability principles to ensure function supports form.


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Design visually impactful, ADA-compliant landing pages and UI components using Figma.
  • Create and repurpose video and animated content for web use—especially in homepage hero sections and brand touchpoints.
  • Skillfully recycle and modify pre-approved design elements, ensuring all changes remain compliant and consistent with brand standards.
  • Maintain a consistent visual language across all digital assets, aligned with brand guidelines.
  • Work collaboratively with marketing and dev teams to implement design updates and assets efficiently.
  • Propose creative design solutions that align with usability, performance, and accessibility requirements.
  • Stay up to date with trends in motion design, UI design, and digital accessibility standards.


Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*

title: PMO - brazil
description:
Você quer fazer parte de uma empresa com propósito? Fazer acontecer inspirando o melhor das pessoas está no DNA da nossa gente.


Prezamos por pessoas que:

• Buscam comprometimento e excelência em suas entregas;

• Criam e disseminam um ambiente colaborativo, com espírito de equipe, onde a amizade é valorizada;

• Queiram atuar com profissionais de confiança;

• E acreditam que o respeito e a humildade são essenciais para o seu dia a dia aqui na Numen.


Se você se identifica com tudo isso e quer ser Numen, não perca a oportunidade de participar desse processo seletivo!


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES


  • Experiência na construção e acompanhamento de KPIs de projetos e na elaboração de planos de comunicação.
  • Vivência em projetos de implementação e integração SAP.
  • Inglês avançado para interação com times multiculturais.


Diferencial:

  • Participação em projetos com responsabilidade sobre o processo de migração de dados e garantia de integridade entre sistemas.


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES


  • Apoiar a rotina diária de gestão de projetos, garantindo o acompanhamento de cronogramas, escopo, riscos, orçamento e entregas.
  • Consolidar informações e status dos projetos, preparando relatórios executivos e painéis de controle (dashboards) com indicadores de desempenho (KPIs).
  • Dar suporte na comunicação entre as equipes do projeto, assegurando o alinhamento entre as partes envolvidas e a atualização das informações nos canais oficiais.
  • Acompanhar planos de ação e pendências, auxiliando os responsáveis no cumprimento dos prazos e metas estabelecidos.
  • Organizar reuniões de acompanhamento, registrando atas, decisões e pontos de atenção.
  • Contribuir para a padronização de processos e metodologias de gestão de projetos, promovendo boas práticas de governança.
  • Monitorar entregáveis e apoiar a preparação de auditorias ou revisões de qualidade.
  • Colaborar com as lideranças e PMs na identificação de riscos, oportunidades de melhoria e otimização dos processos de gestão.


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS


  • Procuramos um(a) profissional com perfil dinâmico(a), flexível e colaborativo(a), que se sinta à vontade em um ambiente de múltiplos projetos e demandas simultâneas, mantendo foco em qualidade, entrega e parceria com o cliente.
  • Contratação efetiva por tempo indeterminado.
  • Atuação 100% Remota.


BENEFÍCIOS


  • Vale transporte
  • Vale Refeição
  • Vale Alimentação
  • Swile Shop
  • TotalPass
  • Vittude
  • Assistência Médica Sulamérica
  • Assistência Odonto Sulamérica
  • Auxílio-Creche
  • Benefício para filhos PCD
  • Previdência Privada
  • Numen School
  • Parcerias educacionais com FIA, FIAP, Moovi, Wise Up e English Pass.

title: Software Engineer Sênior - Vaga afirmativa para mulheres cis e trans
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

title: Trilingual Technical Support Analyst
description:
InvGate is a fast growing SaaS company that develops products for IT management and service automation, used by clients in over 60 countries in industries such as banking, e-commerce, education and technology.


To support our continuous growth we are looking for a Trilingual Technical Support Analyst to join our team.


Some of the role's responsibilities include providing technical and functional support to clients worldwide through different channels such as email, tickets, and remote sessions (Teamviewer/Zoom/etc), checking clients' configurations, suggesting improvements and best practices to maximize the platform's efficiency, and working closely with the development and customer success teams to troubleshoot issues.


Do not hesitate to apply if you…


  • are fluent in English, Spanish and Portuguese (native-level portuguese strongly preffered, C1 level is the minimum required)
  • enjoy working with clients, providing top-level support
  • think analytically
  • have strong communication and troubleshooting skills
  • have previous experience in technical support for software and/or infrastructure
  • are tech-savvy


Having previous experience using InvGate products is a big plus!


We offer real opportunities for professional development, fully covered English classes, technical training both in-house and at educational centers, top-tier health insurance, a fixed amount for purchases in the food sector, reimbursement for remote work, and extended vacation and paternity leave.

title: Video Editor - Freelance
description:
Estamos procurando um(a) editor(a) de vídeo freelance talentoso(a) para criar um vídeo institucional dinâmico e envolvente (aprox. 3 minutos) apresentando nossas plataformas, tecnologias e resultados de forma visualmente impactante.


Responsabilidades

  • Criar um vídeo institucional moderno, fluido e engajador, com cerca de 3 minutos.
  • Trabalhar a partir de materiais fornecidos (capturas de tela, gravações, gráficos, etc.).
  • Traduzir conceitos técnicos em uma narrativa visual clara e atraente.
  • Incluir animações, motion graphics e elementos visuais que tornem a explicação das plataformas interativa.
  • Editar com ritmo, transições e trilha adequadas para manter atenção do público executivo.
  • Garantir consistência visual com a identidade da marca (cores, tipografia, tom).

Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada em edição de vídeos institucionais, explicativos ou de produto.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de edição e motion design (Premiere, After Effects ou equivalentes).
  • Capacidade de transformar conteúdos técnicos em storytelling visual acessível.
  • Olhar estético apurado e atenção a detalhes.
  • Disponibilidade imediata para projeto com deadline em 24/10

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com vídeos para empresas de tecnologia, SaaS ou produtos digitais.

  • Criar um vídeo institucional moderno, fluido e engajador, com cerca de 3 minutos.
  • Trabalhar a partir de materiais fornecidos (capturas de tela, gravações, gráficos, etc.).
  • Traduzir conceitos técnicos em uma narrativa visual clara e atraente.
  • Incluir animações, motion graphics e elementos visuais que tornem a explicação das plataformas interativa.
  • Editar com ritmo, transições e trilha adequadas para manter atenção do público executivo.
  • Garantir consistência visual com a identidade da marca (cores, tipografia, tom).

Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada em edição de vídeos institucionais, explicativos ou de produto.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de edição e motion design (Premiere, After Effects ou equivalentes).
  • Capacidade de transformar conteúdos técnicos em storytelling visual acessível.
  • Olhar estético apurado e atenção a detalhes.
  • Disponibilidade imediata para projeto com deadline em 24/10

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com vídeos para empresas de tecnologia, SaaS ou produtos digitais.

title: .NET UI Developer with Blazor Hybrid
description:
Hey, Dev, check the opportunity we have here at Brick Abode!


About Brick Abode


We are a software development company that serves clients from multiple countries around the world, with differing technological needs. Therefore, we value a good computer science base.


Contractors with a solid understanding of the basic building blocks of today’s technology are really welcome and thrive at Brick Abode.


People here are given autonomy, not put into a box to work only on one thing. They are in touch with the business needs of our clients, sometimes communicating with them directly.


We challenge ourselves to learn new things and go outside our comfort zone. Candidates who are up to the challenge will have an amazing career with us.


If you feel that your values fit with Brick Abode culture, check below for further details about this Position.


What kind of professional are we looking for?


We’re looking for a responsible and proactive professional who can navigate between technology and business contexts with ease, feel comfortable in fast-paced environments, and have great communication skills.

Our team is Brazil and USA-based, and communication is in English. The position is fully remote.



What do I need to have to apply for this position?


  • ASP.NET
  • .NET Core 9
  • Rich UI development in Blazor
  • Proven experience with Web development and the use of REST APIs
  • Working knowledge of Blazor Hybrid (WinForms Blazor)
  • Working knowledge of MVVM (Model-View-ViewModel) for better code separation and maintainability
  • Working knowledge of Secure applications using OAuth, JWT, and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
  • Advanced or Fluent English
  • An academic background (MSc or PhD) will also be a plus


This is an exciting new project where they are developing an innovative system to automate the client's process using robotics.



As Contractor (PJ), you will have:


  • Competitive compensation (in Reais - R$)
  • Work with international clients with international standards
  • Opportunity to grow as a leader
  • Possibility to move between teams
  • Speak in English with your coworkers
  • 2 weeks of paid leave per year
  • National holidays
  • Paid parental leave
  • Paid marriage leave
  • Working with a company that cares about our people and their personal growth
  • All expenses paid for training, conferences, and online courses
  • Remote work
  • Health Care Plan - Online


If you are passionate about technology and have a strong desire to work on cutting-edge projects, we encourage you to apply for this position!


Submit your CV to make sure it contains your LinkedIn and GitHub accounts.

Please submit your resume in English - we can only consider applications submitted in this language.

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
About You

You are a back-end engineer passionate about building scalable, reliable, and maintainable applications. You thrive on writing clean code, applying modern architecture patterns, and leveraging cloud-based solutions. You enjoy solving complex challenges, automating infrastructure, and ensuring that systems are secure, performant, and ready to scale. You’re looking for a company where you can keep growing professionally and directly influence technical excellence.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field; or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in back-end development using Ruby on Rails.
  • Strong experience with AWS services such as Lambda, EC2, S3, RDS, and API Gateway.
  • Hands-on experience using Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC) deployments.
  • Solid understanding of serverless architectures and AWS Lambda functions.
  • Experience designing and consuming RESTful and GraphQL APIs.
  • Knowledge of PostgreSQL, Redis, and background job frameworks (Sidekiq, Resque).
  • Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployments.
  • Experience working with Agile/Scrum methodologies, and proficiency using Jira and Confluence for project tracking.
  • Strong debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills for cross-functional collaboration.
  • Experience with microservices, GoLang, or Node.js for complementary service integration (nice to have).


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain Ruby on Rails applications with a focus on scalability and performance.
  • Build and manage AWS infrastructure components using Terraform and DevOps best practices.
  • Implement and maintain serverless solutions leveraging AWS Lambda and related services.
  • Integrate and maintain APIs and external systems, ensuring reliability and data consistency.
  • Refactor legacy components to improve maintainability, performance, and code clarity.
  • Write and maintain automated tests (RSpec, Minitest) to ensure high code quality and coverage.
  • Monitor application performance and proactively address issues or bottlenecks.
  • Collaborate on CI/CD pipelines, ensuring secure, consistent, and efficient deployments.
  • Participate in code reviews, maintaining high-quality development standards.
  • Engage in Agile ceremonies (standups, sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives).
  • Work closely with front-end, DevOps, and QA teams to deliver robust, end-to-end solutions.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: Python Developer
description:
We are seeking a skilled Python Developer to design and implement RESTful APIs, preferably using Litestar. You will integrate with OpenAI APIs and similar third-party services, focusing on authentication, rate limits, retries, and streaming. Your role will involve building robust data ingestion pipelines, including web scraping, parsing, and normalization. You will write clean, maintainable code, participate in code reviews, and manage CI/CD processes. You will own features end-to-end, from scoping to deployment and monitoring.


Requirements:


  • Solid hands-on experience with Python;
  • Strong knowledge of HTTP/REST, JSON, authentication (JWT/OAuth), and API design
  • Experience with OpenAI APIs (or equivalent) and related tooling
  • Web scraping using requests/ BeautifulSoup/lxml, and Playwright/Selenium
  • Data parsing (regex, JSON/CSV), basic pandas
  • Proficiency in SQL (PostgreSQL or similar), ORMs (SQLAlchemy), and Docker
  • Familiarity with typing, linting, and formatting tools (ruff/black)
  • Clear communication skills, reliability, and the ability to manage your own work

Languages:

  • English

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
We are a collective group of fearless people with a clear purpose: to empower professionals around the world through intelligent workflow automation software. Currently, more than 500 people across 7 countries work with us, remotely or in a hybrid way, to make life easier for over 3,000 companies using Pipefy in more than 180 countries. Since our founding in 2015, we have put people at the center of everything we do, so we invite you to learn more about this position and apply to be part of our team.


Job Description:


We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst with a focus on Business Intelligence, Analytics, and Insights. The ideal candidate will have solid experience in data analysis, with a strong understanding of tools such as SQL and Python. The primary goal is to be able to translate data into actionable insights, supporting strategic decision-making across different business areas such as Sales, Product, Customer Success, and Go-to-Market. Familiarity with data visualization tools (such as Tableau) is desirable.


The professional will be responsible for leading complex data analysis projects, presenting results, and collaborating with different stakeholders to enhance the company's data strategy. Experience in data storytelling is essential, ensuring that insights are communicated and documented clearly and effectively.


* It is important to note that this opportunity is not related to data engineering.


Responsibilities:


- Conduct advanced data analyses to generate insights into business performance, trends, and growth opportunities;

- Communicate insights and strategic recommendations through presentations and data narratives (data storytelling), facilitating decision-making processes;

- Collaborate with different business areas to understand needs and translate business questions into clear and objective data analyses;

- Share knowledge and experience with the entire Data team, fostering technical collaboration and helping to increase the department's data maturity.


Requirements:


- Experience in a data analysis role;

- Strong communication skills;

- Advanced SQL and proficiency in Python (Pandas, NumPy, Plotly, Scikit-learn);

- Apply quantitative techniques to generate business insights;

- Ability to work with cross-functional teams, especially Sales, Product, Customer Success, and Go-to-Market teams;

- Familiarity with data visualization tools (such as Tableau) is desirable.


Benefits:


- Health and Dental Plan

- Individual Life Insurance

- Flexible Hours (in compliance with daily work hours)

- Flexible Meal/Food Allowance

- Home Office Support

- Furniture Assistance

- Psychological Support (for you or legal dependents)

- Wellhub

- Extended Maternity and Paternity Leave

- School/Nanny Allowance

- Supplemental Nutrition Assistance

- Veterinary Plan

- Birthday Day Off

- Marriage Leave (7 days)

- Bereavement Leave for Loved Ones (10 days)

- Bereavement Leave for Adoption or Pet Loss (2 days)

- Individual Funeral Assistance

- Monthly Education Support

- Payroll Loan

- Financial Consulting

- Udemy Corporate Access

title: Full-Time Video AI Prompt Engineer
description:
About Us

Click Bait is a performance-focused creative team that builds direct-response videos for high-growth e-commerce brands. We move fast, test relentlessly, and obsess over outcomes. We’re expanding our AI production capability to scale Video Sales Letters (VSLs) and product ads at volume.


Role Overview

We’re hiring a Video AI Prompt Engineer to generate high-quality AI footage for VSLs and product ads using leading video AI platforms (e.g., Veo 3, Nanobana, Sora 2, or equivalents). You’ll collaborate closely with our creative strategist and editing team, translating concepts into effective prompts, maintaining scene cohesion, and delivering footage that slots neatly into polished, persuasive edits.


Key Responsibilities

  • Generate AI-powered video sequences for VSLs with clear narrative continuity and scene cohesion.
  • Produce compelling product renders and demo visuals that showcase real-world use.
  • Translate briefs/storyboards into precise prompts; iterate rapidly to hit creative and performance goals.
  • Partner with editors to refine pacing, shot selection, and transitions for final production.
  • Leverage AI tools for script-based storytelling, editing assists, and engagement optimization.
  • Proactively experiment with techniques and models to push quality, speed, and reliability.


Qualifications & Skills

  • Proven hands-on experience with Veo 3, Nanobana, Sora 2, or comparable top-tier video AI tools.
  • Strong artistic judgment and creative problem-solving; comfort with direct-response storytelling.
  • Demonstrated ability to maintain visual consistency across multi-shot sequences.
  • Practical video editing fluency (timing, rhythm, narrative arc) and workflow collaboration.
  • Bias to action, ownership mindset, and comfort working in a fast-paced production environment.
  • A portfolio or case studies that showcase relevant AI video work (VSLs, product demos, short-form DR ads).

title: Software Engineer
description:
Description

A Bubble Developer is responsible for designing, developing, and deploying scalable web applications on the Bubble platform, enabling rapid development without extensive coding. This role requires expertise in Bubble’s features, workflows, and plugins to deliver custom solutions tailored to client needs. The ideal candidate excels in written communication for asynchronous collaboration and demonstrates strong self-management and independent problem-solving skills, effectively working with project managers, designers, and developers to meet high standards and project timelines.

Responsibilities
  • Application Development

1.1. Design and develop fully functional web applications using the Bubble platform, ensuring alignment with client requirements, milestones, and business goals.

1.2. Configure workflows, database structures, and API integrations within Bubble to enable seamless functionality.

1.3. Create responsive designs that work across various devices, adhering to UX/UI best practices.

1.4. Utilize Bubble’s visual programming interface to implement features such as user authentication, data management, and third-party API integrations, with a foundational knowledge of Airdev Canvas (training provided in-house if needed).

1.5. Stay up to date with Bubble’s certification requirements to ensure ongoing expertise and alignment with the platform’s latest features and best practices.

2.Customization and Integration

2.1. Leverage Bubble’s plugin marketplace and external APIs to extend application functionality.

2.2. Develop custom workflows and logic to address complex client requirements.

2.3. Work with RESTful APIs and other integration points to enhance the app’s capabilities, ensuring scalability and performance.

3.Testing and Quality Assurance

3.1. Conduct thorough testing of applications to ensure smooth functionality and resolve any bugs or issues before delivery, providing evidence through test cases, such as videos of specific development milestones or flows, as part of the development QA process.

3.2. Collaborate with QA teams or Project Managers to troubleshoot and optimize applications, ensuring high-quality user experiences, and co-leading handoff calls to ensure a smooth transition to the client or next project phase.

4.Documentation

4.1. Maintain comprehensive documentation for each project, including a structured database schema and recorded test case videos to demonstrate key workflows and functionality.

4.2. Create detailed guides for client handoff to facilitate smooth transitions and enable clients to manage the application effectively.

4.3. Adhere to documentation standards to ensure consistency in internal knowledge sharing, supporting scalability and efficient onboarding of team members.

5.Collaboration

5.1. Work closely with project managers, UX/UI designers, and other developers to ensure that the application meets client expectations.

5.2. Participate in project kick-off meetings and client calls to provide input on technical feasibility and development timelines.

5.3. Communicate progress, challenges, and updates to the Project Manager and other stakeholders.

5.4. Mentor junior developers, providing guidance and support to foster their technical growth and integration within the development team.

Qualifications

Experience:

-2+ years of experience developing coded web applications, with at least 2 years of experience specifically on the Bubble platform.

-Strong understanding of Bubble’s database architecture, workflows, and plugin system.

-Experience with third-party API integrations, webhooks, and backend services, including 3rd party db's such as Xano or Supabase.

Skills:

-Expertise in building responsive web applications using Bubble’s interface.

-Solid understanding of web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) and how they are applied in a low-code environment.

-Ability to solve complex problems and design efficient workflows within the Bubble ecosystem.

-Strong english communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams and present technical solutions to non-technical stakeholders.

Tools:

-Proficiency in Bubble.io platform and its various features, including database management, API connections, and plugin usage.

-Familiarity with tools like Figma, n8n, or other platforms that can integrate with Bubble for enhanced functionality.

title: Sales Executive JUNIOR (Fluent English) Remote / U.S. Market Sales Support
description:
Sales Executive JUNIOR (Fluent English) Remote / U.S. Market Sales Support


Na BlueDot BPO Solutions, conectamos talentos do Brasil e da América Latina a empresas globais de alto desempenho. Com mais de 10 anos de experiência em soluções de outsourcing e staff augmentation, atuamos no segmento B2B corporativo, fornecendo profissionais altamente qualificados para posições estratégicas em equipes internacionais. Esta oportunidade é voltada a profissionais com inglês fluente e sólida vivência no ambiente corporativo, que desejam integrar o time de uma empresa norte-americana, atuando de forma 100% remota e em colaboração direta com equipes dos Estados Unidos.


  • Remuneração mensal de R$4.000
  • Trabalho 100% Remoto, de Segunda à Sexta-feira (12h - 21h BRT)
  • Oportunidade de crescimento para funções Senior
  • Exposição internacional e networking com executivos dos EUA
  • Treinamento remunerado de 3 a 5 semanas com preparação para certificações internas (Altamente Desafiador)


What You'll Do

  • Apoiar o time de vendas outbound em campanhas de prospecção (e-mails, LinkedIn, ligações)
  • Qualificar leads B2B e manter o pipeline atualizado e organizado
  • Auxiliar na preparação de materiais e agendas de reuniões comerciais
  • Apoiar apresentações de propostas e acompanhar reuniões executivas
  • Conduzir pesquisas de mercado e identificar novas oportunidades e tendências
  • Manter registros e KPIs atualizados em ferramentas de CRM (Hubspot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, etc)


What We're Looking For

  • 1-3 anos de experiência em Business Sales /Outbound reach, idealmente com mercado internacional
  • Inglês Fluente (C1+ level): nível de fluência e comunicação próximo ao Nível Fluente
  • Perfil Corporativo, familiarizado com tratativas de vendas B2B e ambiente corporativo
  • Perfil Multitasking, carismático, com comunicação clara e assertiva
  • Motivado por metas, resultados claros e que gosta de desempenho mensurável
  • Que esteja habituado a um Fast Paced environment bem como a um ambiente comercial direto, assertivo e focado em resultados


Nice to Have

  • Experiência com ferramentas com ferramentas de prospecção
  • Vivência com o mercado americano ou clientes internacionais
  • Histórico de suporte a processos de vendas B2B


Tech / Ambiente 

  • Equipamento adequado: computador robusto, internet de alta velocidade, headset com bom microfone
  • Ambiente tranquilo para vídeo-chamadas e reuniões externas
  • Preferencialmente 2 monitores


Candidate-se, apenas, caso atenda a todos os critérios da vaga e estiver disposto a crescer em um ambiente comercial internacional exigente e de alta performance.

title: Tecnólogo em Serviços Jurídicos (e notariais)
description:
Resumo da Vaga


O Fantini Advocacia está em busca de profissional formado na faculdade de Tecnologia em Serviços Jurídicos e Notariais para integrar seu time jurídico de forma 100% remota. Essa função é essencial para garantir eficiência, agilidade e qualidade no suporte aos fluxos internos do escritório, desde a contratação até a gestão documental e processual. O(a) candidato(a) ideal será organizado(a), pró-ativo(a) e orientado(a) à solução de problemas. Valorizamos o uso da tecnologia na prática jurídica e buscamos alguém com espírito colaborativo e atenção a detalhes.


Responsabilidades

  • Apoiar os fluxos de contratação de clientes, incluindo a organização e viabilização de documentos;
  • Realizar buscas de informações em bancos de dados públicos e privados;
  • Atuar na organização processual, incluindo protocolo, acompanhamento e atualizações;
  • Executar tratamento e organização de documentos digitais, com foco em conformidade e eficiência;
  • Elaborar planilhas eletrônicas e cálculos jurídicos, especialmente em demandas administrativas e previdenciárias;
  • Aplicar conhecimentos de tecnologia da informação para otimização de rotinas jurídicas;
  • Entrar em contato com clientes para solicitação de informações e documentos, de forma cordial e empática;
  • Auxiliar na gestão de provas e evidências para fundamentação de peças jurídicas;
  • Participar da estruturação de soluções internas para automação de tarefas e controle de prazos;
  • Outras atividades relacionadas ao suporte jurídico e notarial, dentro da competência do curso de Tecnólogo em Serviços Jurídicos e Notariais.


Qualificações

  • Formação completa em Tecnologia em Serviços Jurídicos e Notariais;
  • Domínio de ferramentas como Word, Excel, navegadores e organização de arquivos em nuvem;
  • Habilidade em comunicação oral e escrita;
  • Capacidade de organização, análise crítica e atenção a detalhes;
  • Pró-atividade, responsabilidade e compromisso com prazos;
  • Desejável familiaridade com sistemas jurídicos e processos digitais.


Benefícios

  • Efetivo: salário compatível + ajuda de custo;


A faixa salarial será informada após a primeira fase da seleção.

Fantini Advocacia é um escritório com forte atuação nas áreas de Direito Administrativo e Previdenciário, com foco em soluções personalizadas, tecnológicas e humanas. Se você busca integrar uma equipe dinâmica, com autonomia e oportunidade de crescimento, essa vaga é para você.


Tipo de emprego

Tempo integral

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
About You

You are a back-end engineer passionate about building scalable, reliable, and maintainable applications. You thrive on writing clean code, applying modern architecture patterns, and leveraging cloud-based solutions. You enjoy solving complex challenges, automating infrastructure, and ensuring that systems are secure, performant, and ready to scale. You’re looking for a company where you can keep growing professionally and directly influence technical excellence.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field; or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in back-end development using Ruby on Rails.
  • Strong experience with AWS services such as Lambda, EC2, S3, RDS, and API Gateway.
  • Hands-on experience using Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC) deployments.
  • Solid understanding of serverless architectures and AWS Lambda functions.
  • Experience designing and consuming RESTful and GraphQL APIs.
  • Knowledge of PostgreSQL, Redis, and background job frameworks (Sidekiq, Resque).
  • Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployments.
  • Experience working with Agile/Scrum methodologies, and proficiency using Jira and Confluence for project tracking.
  • Strong debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills for cross-functional collaboration.
  • Experience with microservices, GoLang, or Node.js for complementary service integration (nice to have).


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain Ruby on Rails applications with a focus on scalability and performance.
  • Build and manage AWS infrastructure components using Terraform and DevOps best practices.
  • Implement and maintain serverless solutions leveraging AWS Lambda and related services.
  • Integrate and maintain APIs and external systems, ensuring reliability and data consistency.
  • Refactor legacy components to improve maintainability, performance, and code clarity.
  • Write and maintain automated tests (RSpec, Minitest) to ensure high code quality and coverage.
  • Monitor application performance and proactively address issues or bottlenecks.
  • Collaborate on CI/CD pipelines, ensuring secure, consistent, and efficient deployments.
  • Participate in code reviews, maintaining high-quality development standards.
  • Engage in Agile ceremonies (standups, sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives).
  • Work closely with front-end, DevOps, and QA teams to deliver robust, end-to-end solutions.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*

Your work will directly contribute to refining cutting-edge AI systems (like Gemini) — no prior AI experience required — a great opportunity to build expertise in the growing field of AI.

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and Portuguese)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.

Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. title: SDR (100% remote)
description:
Mandatory - to complete your application, please visit:


SDR - Lead with Precision and Confidence


Are you an assertive, self-confident, and analytic professional who thrives in high-urgency environments? We are looking for a serious, detail-oriented Sales Development Representative (SDR) to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for high-volume outbound prospecting, making calls, sending emails, and using LinkedIn to target facilities managers and maintenance decision-makers.


About WiseVAs

WiseVAs is a premium staffing agency specializing in connecting exceptional remote professionals with businesses seeking top-tier talent. We pride ourselves on our rigorous vetting process and ability to match clients with highly skilled virtual executives.


The Opportunity

As a SDR, you will take charge of outbound prospecting efforts, managing a pipeline of 200-250 daily activities. Your role will focus on making cold calls, navigating gatekeepers, and setting appointments for our closers. Success will be based on your ability to schedule high-quality appointments while managing a strategic outreach approach over a 3-4 month sales cycle.


You will be expected to handle objections professionally, follow a structured process, and ensure that all activities are tracked meticulously. If you are analytical, able to follow rules, and focus on precision and efficiency, we want you to join our team.


Your Responsibilities

  • Make cold calls to facilities managers, navigating gatekeepers and targeting key decision-makers.


  • Manage a high-volume pipeline, following up on leads and ensuring efficient scheduling of appointments.


  • Deliver brief and impactful value propositions to prospects.


  • Schedule appointments for the closing team and ensure timely follow-up on all activities.


  • Track all interactions and maintain organized records in the CRM system.


  • Handle objections in a professional manner, ensuring smooth and productive conversations.


  • Work 40 hours per week, meeting success metrics based on the volume and quality of appointments set.


Required Qualifications

  • Strong English communication skills, with a professional phone demeanor.


  • Previous experience in cold calling and appointment setting.


  • Proven ability to manage a high-volume pipeline and engage in back-and-forth dialogues with prospects.


  • Experience with CRM or tracking systems to manage leads effectively.


  • Reliability to commit to 40 hours per week.


  • No healthcare industry experience required (scripts will be provided).


This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You are uncomfortable working in a high-urgency, fast-paced environment.


  • You prefer not to follow structured processes or workflows.


  • You struggle with multi-tasking and managing a large volume of leads.


Apply now:


This is an external position to work at a WiseVAs client. Considering that the management of job positions is entirely handled by the hiring companies, and that WiseVAs operates solely as an intermediary between the candidate and the hiring company, the submission of proposals by candidates does not guarantee employment. Similarly, candidates acknowledge and authorize the storage of resumes and proposals in WiseVAs's database, as well as the receipt of messages, emails, and calls offering new job positions and opportunities.
