title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
About Ótmow

Ótmow is a fast-growing fintech startup reshaping financial access for companies that work with the Brazilian government. We empower these businesses with seamless, secure, and accessible financial solutions in order to provide essential government services with confidence.


About the Role

We’re looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer who treats AI as a partner, not just a tool. You’ll build end-to-end features across the stack while creatively leveraging AI to accelerate development, automate workflows, and design scalable, flexible systems.

You’ll work in a fast-moving environment focused on transforming complex data into intelligent products. From building a credit matrix and automating sales/marketing workflows to designing dashboards and public-data scrapers, you’ll directly shape Ótmow’s core technology.


Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain features using React (TypeScript) and Python (FastAPI or Flask) .
  • Collaborate with AI tools (GPT, Claude, Cursor, etc.) to speed up coding, automate tasks, and improve quality.
  • Design and execute web scraping jobs to extract structured data from public transparency portals.
  • Develop and integrate infrastructure on GCP (Cloud Run, Firestore, Firebase Auth) and Supabase (PostgreSQL) .
  • Implement product features such as credit matrices, automation tools, and performance dashboards.
  • Ensure data integrity and quality across systems.
  • Actively participate in architecture design, code reviews, and planning sessions.
  • Experiment with emerging AI models and evaluate their potential for development, automation, and decision support.


Required Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in full-stack development.
  • Strong proficiency with TypeScript and React .
  • Solid experience with Python and backend frameworks (FastAPI, Flask ).
  • Experience with web scraping (Playwright, BeautifulSoup, requests).
  • Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and version control (Git, CI/CD) .
  • Fluency in AI-assisted development tools such as GPT, Claude, Cursor, etc.
  • Ability to work independently and communicate clearly in a remote setup.
  • Advanced English (for documentation and discussions) and Native Portuguese (for technical and business communication).
  • Ability to work under Pessoa Jurídica (PJ) in Brazil.


Preferred Skills

  • Experience scraping dynamic websites or handling anti-bot systems.
  • Background in data-driven products or credit/fintech platforms.
  • Knowledge of AI APIs or model fine-tuning.
  • Experience automating developer workflows using AI tools.


Why Join Us?

You’ll be part of a company at the intersection of fintech, data, and AI , redefining how public-sector suppliers access credit in Brazil, to build impactful, scalable solutions. And more ...

  • Competitive salary + performance bonuses.
  • Potential for equity participation, sharing in Ótmow’s long-term success.
  • Opportunity to transform a traditional sector with cutting-edge fintech solutions.
  • Flexible hours and remote-friendly culture.
  • Join a collaborative, diverse global team where different backgrounds, perspectives, and ideas drive innovation.

You’ll work in a fast-moving environment focused on transforming complex data into intelligent products. From building a credit matrix and automating sales/marketing workflows to designing dashboards and public-data scrapers, you’ll directly shape Ótmow’s core technology.

Required Skills

Publica.la es una plataforma SaaS B2B utilizada por cientos de editoriales, librerías y bibliotecas en todo el mundo para gestionar y potenciar sus ventas de contenido digital.

Nuestra plataforma multi-tenant procesa millones de transacciones en 156 países , administrando bibliotecas digitales, suscripciones y e-commerce a gran escala.

Buscamos un/a Desarrollador/a Frontend Senior para construir interfaces de usuario atractivas, accesibles y de alto rendimiento , utilizando Livewire, Alpine.js y Tailwind CSS .

  • Implementar interacciones ligeras con Alpine.js , siguiendo principios de diseño mobile-first.
  • Estilizar interfaces con Tailwind CSS , asegurando el cumplimiento de las normas de accesibilidad WCAG 2.1 AA .

  • Optimizar el rendimiento del frontend: lazy loading, optimización de bundles, estrategias de caché.
  • Escribir tests y mantener la calidad del código con herramientas modernas.
  • Participar en revisiones de diseño y contribuir a mejoras de UI/UX .


Stack tecnológico

Tecnologías: Laravel, Livewire, Alpine.js, Tailwind CSS, Vue.js

También en el proyecto: PHP, SingleStore, Valkey/Redis, Docker, GitLab CI/CD


Podrías encajar si tienes

  • Más de 6 años de experiencia en desarrollo frontend , con fuerte dominio de arquitecturas basadas en componentes.
  • Conocimiento profundo de Livewire , Alpine.js u otros frameworks reactivos similares (al menos 1 año de experiencia).
  • Experiencia con Tailwind CSS u otros frameworks utility-first.
  • Foco en accesibilidad (WCAG 2.1 AA) y diseño mobile-first.
  • Experiencia construyendo interfaces responsivas y de alto rendimiento para plataformas SaaS.
  • Comodidad trabajando dentro del ecosistema Laravel (se valora comprensión básica de PHP).
  • Nivel nativo o conversacional de español , y buenas habilidades de comunicación escrita en inglés y español (el 90% de nuestra comunicación es asincrónica y escrita).
  • Mentalidad proactiva y capacidad para trabajar eficazmente en un entorno remoto.
  • Portugués es un plus.


Deseable

  • Experiencia desarrollando con Vue.js .
  • Experiencia en interfaces multi-tenant y sistemas de control de acceso basado en roles (RBAC) .
  • Conocimiento del templating de Laravel Blade y renderizado del lado del servidor.
  • Experiencia con herramientas de build modernas (Vite , Webpack ).
  • Experiencia en testing frontend con Playwright .
  • Conocimientos en optimización de rendimiento web .
  • Experiencia trabajando con design systems y bibliotecas de componentes.
  • Contribuciones a proyectos frontend open source .


Cómo trabajamos

  • Equipo 100% remoto distribuido en diferentes zonas horarias.
  • Comunicación asincrónica por defecto, con documentación clara y escrita.
  • Valoramos el código limpio , la accesibilidad y la mantenibilidad .
  • Enfoque en el aprendizaje continuo y actualización tecnológica constante.
  • Cuidamos la experiencia y productividad del desarrollador .
  • Entorno colaborativo donde tu opinión cuenta en decisiones clave.
  • Interacción directa con clientes para entender sus necesidades y mejorar el producto.


Proceso de selección

  • Conversación inicial sobre tu experiencia y objetivos profesionales.
  • Evaluación técnica enfocada en Livewire y arquitectura de componentes.
  • Entrevista técnica con el equipo de ingeniería para revisar tu evaluación.
  • Charla con nuestro CEO sobre la visión de la empresa y el encaje cultural.
  • Oferta.
  • Coordinación de onboarding y fecha de inicio.


Salario y beneficios

  • Salario competitivo en USD , según experiencia y ubicación.
  • Trabajo 100% remoto con horarios flexibles.
  • Estructura laboral basada en resultados .
  • Entorno de trabajo colaborativo, creativo y dinámico .
  • Oportunidad de trabajar en una plataforma líder en publicación digital .
  • Vacaciones ilimitadas.
  • Actividades de equipo ocasionales, 100% cubiertas por Publica.la .
  • Reembolso por libros adquiridos a través de nuestra plataforma.
  • Oportunidades de desarrollo profesional dentro de la empresa.


Cómo postularte

Envíanos lo siguiente:

  • Tu CV / currículum
  • Enlaces a proyectos en los que hayas trabajado (GitHub, portafolio, CodePen, etc.)

Work location: Heredia, Costa Rica & remote for LATAM

English Required: B2+ - C1

Job Summary:

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Full Stack Developer with deep expertise in Java Spring Boot, Ruby on Rails, and Angular to lead complex application development initiatives. The ideal candidate will be a strong technical contributor with a proven track record in building scalable, high-performance systems. While excelling in backend implementation and frontend execution. This role is ideal for a technically strong developer who is ready to expand their impact beyond code delivery into collaborative leadership, stakeholder communication, and architectural decision-making.

Require Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of professional experience in Java Spring Boot and core Java (OOP, data structures, algorithms).
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with Ruby on Rails and full-stack web development.
  • Proven experience with Angular and modern frontend technologies (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js).
  • Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and cloud-native development.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git, Docker, and deployment automation tools.
  • Effective communication across global teams.

  • Proactively identify risks and implement mitigation strategies in project planning and execution.
  • Contribute to migration projects, system modernization, and platform upgrades with minimal disruption.

title: En español - Senior Full Stack Senior (Enfoque Backend)
description:
• Desarrollador/a Full Stack Senior (Enfoque Backend)
  • Remoto (preferencia zona horaria UTC-3 a UTC+2)
  • Jornada completa


Qué hacemos

Publica.la es una plataforma SaaS B2B utilizada por cientos de editoriales, librerías y bibliotecas en todo el mundo para gestionar y potenciar sus ventas de contenido digital.

Nuestra plataforma multi-tenant procesa millones de transacciones en 156 países , administrando bibliotecas digitales, suscripciones y e-commerce a gran escala.

Buscamos un Desarrollador/a Full Stack Senior con fuerte experiencia en backend para ayudarnos a construir y escalar los sistemas centrales que impulsan este crecimiento, trabajando con Laravel/PHP , SingleStore , arquitectura multi-tenant y sistemas distribuidos .

Qué harás
  • Diseñar y desarrollar nuevas funcionalidades para nuestra plataforma SaaS multi-tenant, con foco en los servicios backend.
  • Construir y mantener aplicaciones escalables en Laravel utilizando PHP , SingleStore y Valkey/Redis .
  • Trabajar con bases de datos SQL distribuidas (SingleStore) e implementar patrones eficientes de aislamiento de datos multi-tenant .
  • Desarrollar y optimizar procesos en background basados en colas para la ingesta de contenido, pagos y analítica.
  • Colaborar con desarrolladores frontend en la integración con Livewire y Alpine.js .
  • Garantizar la calidad del código mediante testing (PHPUnit/Pest ), análisis estático (PHPStan ) y revisiones de código.
  • Participar en decisiones de arquitectura y planificación técnica para la escalabilidad de la plataforma.
  • Trabajar directamente con clientes para entender sus necesidades y mejorar el producto.
  • Mantener y mejorar funcionalidades existentes, asegurando rendimiento y confiabilidad .
Nuestro stack tecnológico

Tecnologías: PHP con Laravel, Livewire, Alpine.js, TailwindCSS, Laravel Nova, Valkey/Redis

Infraestructura: SingleStore, AWS Lambda, AWS S3, Cloudflare Workers, Docker, GitLab CI/CD


Podrías encajar si tienes
  • Más de 6 años de experiencia en desarrollo Full Stack , con fuerte enfoque en backend.
  • Amplia experiencia en PHP y Laravel (mínimo 3 años trabajando con el framework).
  • Sólidos conocimientos de bases de datos SQL .
  • Experiencia construyendo y escalando aplicaciones SaaS multi-tenant .
  • Fuerte comprensión de arquitecturas basadas en colas y procesamiento en background.
  • Experiencia con frameworks de testing (PHPUnit/Pest) y herramientas de análisis estático .
  • Nivel nativo o conversacional de español , y buenas habilidades de comunicación escrita en inglés y español (la mayoría de la comunicación es asincrónica y escrita).
  • Mentalidad proactiva y capacidad para trabajar eficazmente en un equipo remoto.
  • Portugués es un plus.
Deseable
  • Conocimientos de principios UX y capacidad para colaborar con diseñadores.
  • Experiencia frontend con frameworks modernos de JavaScript y arquitecturas basadas en componentes.
  • Experiencia con SingleStore u otras bases de datos SQL distribuidas (TiDB , CockroachDB ).
  • Experiencia desarrollando con Livewire y Alpine.js .
  • Experiencia con el panel de administración Laravel Nova .
  • Experiencia con AWS Lambda y arquitecturas serverless .
  • Integración con pasarelas de pago (Stripe, MercadoPago).
  • Experiencia en pipelines de procesamiento de contenido (PDF, EPUB, archivos de audio).
  • Familiaridad con SAML 2.0 y OAuth .
  • Experiencia con plataformas de e-commerce y facturación por suscripción .
  • Contribuciones a proyectos open source o paquetes Laravel .
Cómo trabajamos
  • Equipo 100% remoto trabajando en diferentes zonas horarias.
  • Comunicación asincrónica como estándar, con documentación clara y escrita.
  • Valoramos la calidad del código , el testing y la mantenibilidad .
  • Promovemos el aprendizaje continuo y mantenerse al día con las últimas tecnologías.
  • Fuerte enfoque en la experiencia y productividad del desarrollador .
  • Entorno colaborativo donde tu opinión importa en decisiones clave.
  • Interacción directa con clientes para comprender sus necesidades reales.
Proceso de selección
  • Conversación inicial sobre tu experiencia y objetivos profesionales.
  • Evaluación técnica enfocada en Laravel y arquitectura backend.
  • Entrevista técnica con el equipo de ingeniería para revisar tu evaluación.
  • Charla con nuestro CEO sobre la visión de la empresa y el encaje cultural.
  • Oferta.
  • Coordinación del onboarding y fecha de inicio.
Salario y beneficios
  • Salario competitivo en USD , según experiencia y ubicación.
  • Trabajo 100% remoto con horarios flexibles.
  • Estructura laboral basada en resultados .
  • Entorno de trabajo colaborativo, creativo y dinámico .
  • Oportunidad de trabajar en una plataforma líder de publicación digital .
  • Vacaciones ilimitadas.
  • Actividades de equipo ocasionales, 100% cubiertas por Publica.la.
  • Reembolso por libros adquiridos a través de nuestra plataforma.
  • Oportunidades de desarrollo profesional dentro de la empresa.
Cómo postularte

Envíanos lo siguiente:

  • Tu CV / currículum
  • Enlaces a proyectos en los que hayas trabajado (perfil de GitHub, portafolio, etc.)
  • Tus expectativas salariales
  • Una breve nota sobre por qué quieres formar parte de Publica.la

Envía tu postulación a

con el asunto: Senior Full Stack Developer (Backend Focus)

title: En español - Senior Full Stack Senior (Enfoque Backend)
description:
• Desarrollador/a Full Stack Senior (Enfoque Backend)
  • Remoto (preferencia zona horaria UTC-3 a UTC+2)
  • Jornada completa


Qué hacemos

Publica.la es una plataforma SaaS B2B utilizada por cientos de editoriales, librerías y bibliotecas en todo el mundo para gestionar y potenciar sus ventas de contenido digital.

Nuestra plataforma multi-tenant procesa millones de transacciones en 156 países , administrando bibliotecas digitales, suscripciones y e-commerce a gran escala.

Buscamos un Desarrollador/a Full Stack Senior con fuerte experiencia en backend para ayudarnos a construir y escalar los sistemas centrales que impulsan este crecimiento, trabajando con Laravel/PHP , SingleStore , arquitectura multi-tenant y sistemas distribuidos .

Qué harás
  • Diseñar y desarrollar nuevas funcionalidades para nuestra plataforma SaaS multi-tenant, con foco en los servicios backend.
  • Construir y mantener aplicaciones escalables en Laravel utilizando PHP , SingleStore y Valkey/Redis .
  • Trabajar con bases de datos SQL distribuidas (SingleStore) e implementar patrones eficientes de aislamiento de datos multi-tenant .
  • Desarrollar y optimizar procesos en background basados en colas para la ingesta de contenido, pagos y analítica.
  • Colaborar con desarrolladores frontend en la integración con Livewire y Alpine.js .
  • Garantizar la calidad del código mediante testing (PHPUnit/Pest ), análisis estático (PHPStan ) y revisiones de código.
  • Participar en decisiones de arquitectura y planificación técnica para la escalabilidad de la plataforma.
  • Trabajar directamente con clientes para entender sus necesidades y mejorar el producto.
  • Mantener y mejorar funcionalidades existentes, asegurando rendimiento y confiabilidad .
Nuestro stack tecnológico

Tecnologías: PHP con Laravel, Livewire, Alpine.js, TailwindCSS, Laravel Nova, Valkey/Redis

Infraestructura: SingleStore, AWS Lambda, AWS S3, Cloudflare Workers, Docker, GitLab CI/CD


Podrías encajar si tienes
  • Más de 6 años de experiencia en desarrollo Full Stack , con fuerte enfoque en backend.
  • Amplia experiencia en PHP y Laravel (mínimo 3 años trabajando con el framework).
  • Sólidos conocimientos de bases de datos SQL .
  • Experiencia construyendo y escalando aplicaciones SaaS multi-tenant .
  • Fuerte comprensión de arquitecturas basadas en colas y procesamiento en background.
  • Experiencia con frameworks de testing (PHPUnit/Pest) y herramientas de análisis estático .
  • Nivel nativo o conversacional de español , y buenas habilidades de comunicación escrita en inglés y español (la mayoría de la comunicación es asincrónica y escrita).
  • Mentalidad proactiva y capacidad para trabajar eficazmente en un equipo remoto.
  • Portugués es un plus.
Deseable
  • Conocimientos de principios UX y capacidad para colaborar con diseñadores.
  • Experiencia frontend con frameworks modernos de JavaScript y arquitecturas basadas en componentes.
  • Experiencia con SingleStore u otras bases de datos SQL distribuidas (TiDB , CockroachDB ).
  • Experiencia desarrollando con Livewire y Alpine.js .
  • Experiencia con el panel de administración Laravel Nova .
  • Experiencia con AWS Lambda y arquitecturas serverless .
  • Integración con pasarelas de pago (Stripe, MercadoPago).
  • Experiencia en pipelines de procesamiento de contenido (PDF, EPUB, archivos de audio).
  • Familiaridad con SAML 2.0 y OAuth .
  • Experiencia con plataformas de e-commerce y facturación por suscripción .
  • Contribuciones a proyectos open source o paquetes Laravel .
Cómo trabajamos
  • Equipo 100% remoto trabajando en diferentes zonas horarias.
  • Comunicación asincrónica como estándar, con documentación clara y escrita.
  • Valoramos la calidad del código , el testing y la mantenibilidad .
  • Promovemos el aprendizaje continuo y mantenerse al día con las últimas tecnologías.
  • Fuerte enfoque en la experiencia y productividad del desarrollador .
  • Entorno colaborativo donde tu opinión importa en decisiones clave.
  • Interacción directa con clientes para comprender sus necesidades reales.
Proceso de selección
  • Conversación inicial sobre tu experiencia y objetivos profesionales.
  • Evaluación técnica enfocada en Laravel y arquitectura backend.
  • Entrevista técnica con el equipo de ingeniería para revisar tu evaluación.
  • Charla con nuestro CEO sobre la visión de la empresa y el encaje cultural.
  • Oferta.
  • Coordinación del onboarding y fecha de inicio.
Salario y beneficios
  • Salario competitivo en USD , según experiencia y ubicación.
  • Trabajo 100% remoto con horarios flexibles.
  • Estructura laboral basada en resultados .
  • Entorno de trabajo colaborativo, creativo y dinámico .
  • Oportunidad de trabajar en una plataforma líder de publicación digital .
  • Vacaciones ilimitadas.
  • Actividades de equipo ocasionales, 100% cubiertas por Publica.la.
  • Reembolso por libros adquiridos a través de nuestra plataforma.
  • Oportunidades de desarrollo profesional dentro de la empresa.

Envíanos lo siguiente:

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Software Mobile - Especialista (Flutter)
description:
O que você precisa para essa posição:


Formação Acadêmica

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou experiência prática equivalente.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar na construção de uma arquitetura mobile escalável e de fácil entendimento;
  • Atuar na identificação e correção de bugs e comportamentos não desejáveis;
  • Acompanhar de forma ativa a saúde das aplicações mobile utilizando-se de métricas e relatórios;
  • Colaborar de forma ativa junto às squads no planejamento, desenvolvimento e entrega de novas funcionalidades;
  • Escrever cenários de testes automatizados buscando uma cobertura de testes ampla e confiável;
  • Trabalhar de forma contínua na identificação de melhorias e otimizações de performance;
  • Zelar pela qualidade das aplicações mobile junto às lojas;
  • Zelar pela segurança das aplicações mobile.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Sólidos conhecimentos em desenvolvimento de aplicativos utilizando Flutter;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de aplicativos nativos (Android com Kotlin/Java e/ou iOS com Swift/Obj-C) ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em desenvolvimento de aplicativos utilizando gestão de estados no padrão Bloc ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em desenvolvimento de aplicativos com Arquitetura Limpa ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em testes unitários, integração, instrumentados e E2E ;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de aplicativos modulares/multi-lib ;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de design systems ;
  • Experiência com diferentes Arquiteturas e Padrões de Projetos;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos com análise e monitoramento de erros de aplicativos em produção ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos com processo de releases nas lojas de aplicativos Google Play/Apple Store;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos com desenvolvimento e automação de esteiras de delivery .


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com frameworks e padrões de segurança, como OWASP, NIST, ISO/IEC 27001 e em programa de Security Champions.


E aí curtiu?

Inscreva-se e faça parte do nosso time!

title: Cloud Software Engineer
description:
Progress Rail is seeking a motivated and skilled Cloud Engineer to join its dynamic team. This full-time remote position reports directly to the Cloud Manager and plays a key role in designing and maintaining scalable, reliable cloud infrastructure that supports our cutting-edge rail technology solutions. The role requires independent judgment, strong problem-solving abilities, resourcefulness, and the capacity to navigate ambiguity with creativity and initiative. The ideal candidate is a self-starter with a solid background in cloud technologies, capable of balancing speed, quality, and cost-effectiveness to meet both customer and business needs.


Job Purpose:

In this role, the candidate is responsible developing & maintaining ETL/ELD ingestion, API, Web and cloud systems, that deliver real time Railroad data to customers.


About us:

As a Caterpillar company, Progress Rail is one of the largest integrated diversified providers of locomotive, freight car and infrastructure solutions and technologies for the global rail industry. Our team's deep industry expertise ensures a commitment to quality through innovative solutions.


Job Responsibilities:

  • Maintain and develop new features for Ruby on Rails web application used for software and model simulation management.
  • Maintain and enhance the ETL, web and API systems.
  • Ensure the systems are highly available, scalable, and performant.
  • Work with Amazon AWS services to deploy, monitor, and manage the systems.
  • Collaborate with other engineers to design and implement new features.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues in the production environment.
  • Optimize the performance of the systems and ensure they meet security standards.
  • Document the design, implementation, and operation of the systems.
  • Architect and maintain front end web applications.


Technical Skill

  • Experience maintaining and developing new features in Ruby on Rails web applications, particularly those used for software and model simulation management.
  • Experience in backend development with a modern programming language such as Python.
  • Proven experience with ETL systems and API microservices development.
  • Strong knowledge of AWS services and cloud architecture.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing.
  • Experience building and deploying high-quality front-end web applications in Angular/Vue, React.


Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with video streaming services.
  • Familiarity with container orchestration tools like Kubernetes.
  • Deep understanding of microservices architecture.
  • Experience with monitoring and logging tools.
  • Familiarity with Java SpringBoot.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, Redis, MongoDB, Docker, and Websockets.


Required Education

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field.


Language:

Advanced English. Direct interface with global teams. Reporting to a Manager in the US.


Soft Skills:

  • Compatibility with Our Values in Action (Caterpillar Code of Conduct);
  • Autonomy : Being able to manage yourself, deal with a large number of tasks and solve minor problems proactively and responsibly.
  • Communication : Can clearly express ideas, thoughts and concepts in order to influence others or gain support.
  • Problem Solving : Able to carefully analyze situations, understand the details and root causes of problems, and resolve them independently and effectively.
  • Attention to Detail: Capable of thoroughly reviewing and interpreting facts, plans, or projects, contributing to quality assurance and impact analysis.
  • Systemic Thinking: Able to see and understand the bigger picture, identifying processes, departments, and connections, as well as how they impact the final delivery.


What we are offering for this position:

- CLT contract

- Health insurance for you and your dependents

- Dental plan for you and your dependents

- Meal vouchers

- Food voucher

- Life insurance

- Application for discounts at gyms

- Application for discounts on medicines in pharmacies

- PLR - Profit Sharing

- Private pension plan

- Continuing education allowance

- Extended maternity and paternity leave

title: Creative Director
description:
Are you looking to work for an innovative and exciting company from Silicon Valley or New York, 100% remotely?


We are looking for multi-skilled candidates with excellent interpersonal skills for the position of Creative Director.


We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced professional who is passionate about driving creative strategies and execution across performance marketing campaigns. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in leading the creation of high-converting ad creatives, managing a creative team, and collaborating with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced, results-driven environment.


The salary range is $1,500 USD to $ 3,000 USD per month, depending on the candidate's experience and seniority.


Candidates from other Latin American countries may be considered. Candidates in a time zone outside of the western hemisphere will NOT be considered.


The role is 100% remote.


ALL RESUMES MUST BE SUBMITTED IN ENGLISH


Responsibilities:


  • Lead the creative strategy and execution for all performance marketing campaigns.
  • Write direct response sales copy for ad headlines, video scripts, graphic ads, etc.
  • Script compelling video ads optimized for platforms like YouTube, Meta, and TikTok.
  • Source, find, hire, and work with UGC creators to build an in-house UGC creation team for ad filming.
  • Use AI tools (e.g., Google VEO 3, MidJourney, ChatGPT) to create, prototype, and scale ad creatives efficiently.
  • Collaborate with media buyers, funnel strategists, UGC creators, and clients to continuously improve ad performance.
  • Provide art direction for designers and video editors; bonus points if you can edit video or graphic design yourself.
  • Manage and mentor a small creative team and UGC creators to ensure alignment with brand tone, campaign goals, and ROI targets.
  • Track performance metrics and iterate based on real-time campaign data.


Requirements:


  • 5+ years of experience in creative leadership within direct-response marketing, performance marketing, or info/lead gen businesses.
  • A killer sales copywriting portfolio showcasing a deep understanding of psychological triggers, offers, and funnel optimization.
  • Expert-level understanding of direct-response marketing principles.
  • Demonstrable skill in scripting video ads that engage and convert, and writing for UGC creators to act out your scripts.
  • Familiarity and experience using AI creative tools like Google VEO 3, MidJourney, ChatGPT, etc.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines.
  • Bonus: Hands-on video editing skills in tools like Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, or similar.


Additionally, we’ll make sure to screen for applicants who:

  • Have worked on high-ticket digital offers (webinars, call booking funnels, lead gen funnels).
  • Are familiar with platforms and tools like Hyros, ClickFunnels, and GoHigh Level.
  • Know and follow industry figures like Russell Brunson, Grant Cardone, Rudy Mawer, and Tai Lopez.
  • Can provide a portfolio that includes direct-response Facebook ad creatives (not eCommerce or branding ads).

A FCamara está em busca de uma Pessoa Desenvolvedora Back-End Java Sênior, em parceria com uma das maiores empresas de solução digital, voltada ao e-commerce que tem atuação em mais de 60 anos de história, com mais de 1.000 lojas físicas, 28 centros de distribuição e mais de 33 milhões de produtos no marketplace.

  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de APIs RESTful robustas e escaláveis utilizando Java e Spring Boot.

  • Desenvolver testes unitários garantindo a qualidade do código.

title: Software Engineer Mobile Sênior
description:
Quem é Stone Tech?

A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Nossa cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

title: Search Engine Optimization Specialist
description:
SEO Specialist

Remote : Latin America

Rate : USD $8-12/hr

Contract Role


SEO/TECHNICAL SKILLS

  • SEO migration - redirection mapping and implementation
  • Knowledge of technical SEO components (canonicalization, XML sitemaps, keyword cannibalization, robots.txt, schema), investigating indexation and crawl errors , conducting site audits
  • Familiarity and applied experience with tools such as Screaming Frog, Google Search Console, SEMRush (other SEO tools like Ahrefs or Moz) and Google Analytics
  • Strong understanding of core SEO concepts such as crawlability, renderability, and indexability, links, keyword research and content
  • Implement on-page optimizations to enhance page/content relevance, meta tags and content for improved search engine performance
  • Understanding of front-end web technologies including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Schema Markup
  • Identify strategic opportunities to grow organic traffic across the business

LOCAL SEO:

Google Business profile optimization

Experience in hyperlocal SEO, including location business listing management across online directories

EXPERIENCE:

SEO migrations

Experience doing technical SEO at scale

Experience working with (and analyzing) large amounts of data

Spreadsheets

SOFT SKILLS:

Collaboration

Pro-active problem solving

Ability to work under tight deadlines

Attention to detail

Accountability

Self-motivated

title: Closer Digital
description:
VAGA ABERTA: CLOSER DIGITAL – ALTA PERFORMANCE EM VENDAS



Você é fera em fechar vendas, domina conversas estratégicas e busca crescimento acelerado no mercado digital?

A RedSuit quer você no time! Procuramos Closers que transformam oportunidades em vendas de alto valor, com performance acima da média e sede por resultados.


O que é um Closer Digital?

O Closer Digital atua na última etapa do funil de vendas, recebendo leads já qualificados por Social Sellers, marketing e tráfego pago.

Seu foco é converter esses leads em clientes, conduzindo calls estratégicas via Google Meet, aplicando técnicas de venda consultiva, lidando com objeções e levando o cliente ao "sim".

Sem prospecção ativa ou criação de conteúdo – você foca 100% no fechamento.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Conduzir chamadas de vendas via Google Meet com leads qualificados
  • Diagnosticar dores e necessidades reais do cliente
  • Apresentar a proposta de forma clara, estratégica e persuasiva
  • Fechar vendas de produtos digitais de alto valor (mentorias, consultorias, cursos)
  • Realizar follow-ups inteligentes para aumentar conversão
  • Atualizar e gerenciar o CRM (Kommo) com consistência
  • Participar de reuniões semanais com o time comercial e marketing
  • O que esperamos de vocêExperiência comprovada como Closer ou em vendas consultivas digitais
  • Comunicação de alto nível, escuta ativa e foco em solução
  • Disciplina para cumprir metas e manter rotina de fechamento
  • Conhecimento em funis de vendas, CRM e gestão de leads
  • Estrutura para trabalho remoto (PC/Laptop + celular)
  • Perfil movido por resultados, aprendizado contínuo e crescimento


O que oferecemos:

  • Fixo base + comissões agressivas (OTE: R$5.000 a R$10.000/mês, ganhos escaláveis)
  • Mentoria e treinamentos exclusivos
  • Trabalho 100% remoto, com flexibilidade de horário
  • Contrato PJ
  • Oportunidade de crescer junto a grandes projetos do mercado digital


Nossa Cultura

Na RedSuit, alta performance é padrão. Valorizamos aprendizado contínuo, ambiente leve e colaborativo e a busca incessante por resultados reais para nossos clientes.

Aqui, cada venda é uma transformação na vida de quem confia no nosso trabalho.

title: Supervisora de R&S - SP ou CTBA (Home Office) - PJ
description:
Supervisora de R&S | Foco em Volume & Resultados (Home Office) - PJ


Você é uma profissional de RH que tem experiência com processos de volume, já atuou em empresas / Consultoria de RH, empresas de BPO ou Teleatendimento ? Buscamos uma Supervisora de RH (Modelo PJ) para ser a chave do nosso crescimento!

Seu principal desafio será gerir o nosso time de R&S, garantindo agilidade nas entregas de alto volume e qualidade em vagas de média/alta complexidade. Queremos crescer e você será essencial nesse processo.



Por que esta é a oportunidade PJ ideal?


  • Remuneração Fixa : R$ 2.000,00 + Variáveis sobre atingimento do time de seleção.
  • Potencial de Ganhos: R$ 3.000,00 a R$ 6.000,00/mês.


Autonomia e Flexibilidade: Trabalho 100% Home Office .

Parceria Estratégica: Buscamos um relacionamento de longo prazo, focado no sucesso mútuo e na construção de um setor de gestão moderna e escalável.



O que você fará (Seu Desafio)

  • Gestão de Processos: Gerenciar e monitorar processos de R&S de alto e médio volume, garantindo a qualidade e agilidade nas entregas.
  • Controle e Estratégia: Otimizar os controles diários e ser a interface estratégica para alinhar expectativas e garantir a satisfação dos clientes.
  • Suporte ao Time: Apoiar a equipe de R&S nos projetos em andamento, garantindo que tenham as ferramentas e o foco necessários.


O Perfil que Buscamos (Diferenciais Chave)

  • Liderança Comprovada: Experiência sólida em Recrutamento e Seleção e vivência em gestão ou liderança de equipes.
  • Volume é Essencial: Ter experiência com R&S de ALTO VOLUME será um GRANDE DIFERENCIAL.

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
About the company:

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.


About the opportunity:

We are seeking a motivated DevOps Engineer to support our cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines in a dynamic

environment leveraging Kubernetes, AWS, GCP, Postgres, and Terraform. In this role, you will participate in automating

infrastructure provisioning, managing containerized applications,and maintaining CI/CD workflows to ensure smooth and

scalable deployments. You will work closely with senior engineers to troubleshoot issues, implement best practices, and

enhance system reliability and performance across multi-cloud platforms. This is an excellent opportunity to grow your skills in a

fast-paced, collaborative DevOps environment.


work MST or PST hours.



What you get to do every day:

-Participate in an on-call rotation on a regular basis and respond to incidents reliably and professionally.

-Maintain and evolve our AWS cloud infrastructure, employing automation, and infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.

-Build and maintain our code pipelines, designing and building automation in order to enable agile software development, using self-service where possible.

-Collaborate efficiently and effectively with other team members and Software Engineers to solve complex problems.

-Quickly absorb context and knowledge while ramping up.


✅Skills/Experience:

Minimum Requirements:

-4-6 years experience in SRE, DevOps, or similar role

-Experience with cloud provider platforms such as AWS or GCP

-Experience with relational databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL)

-Familiarity with Kubernetes

- Experience with GitOps CI/CD tools (e.g., Harness, Argo, Flux,Jenkins)

- Familiarity with declarative infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g.,Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi)

-Exposure to logging, monitoring, metrics collection, and observability tools (e.g., DataDog, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, CloudWatch)



✨Desired Skills (Nice to Haves):

- Experience with software development and automation in

languages beyond shell scripting (e.g., golang, python, elixir,java, etc.)

- Experience with platform development of tools for development, staging, and integration environments

- Experience with debugging performance or networking issues in applications running on Kubernetes

- Experience with audit compliance (e.g., SOX, SOC2, ISO27001, PCI DSS)

- Working knowledge of UNIX-based Operating Systems

-Computer Science or Engineering degree



Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
About You

You are a back-end engineer passionate about building scalable, reliable, and maintainable applications. You thrive on writing clean code, applying modern architecture patterns, and leveraging cloud-based solutions. You enjoy solving complex challenges, automating infrastructure, and ensuring that systems are secure, performant, and ready to scale. You’re looking for a company where you can keep growing professionally and directly influence technical excellence.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field; or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in back-end development using Ruby on Rails.
  • Strong experience with AWS services such as Lambda, EC2, S3, RDS, and API Gateway.
  • Hands-on experience using Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC) deployments.
  • Solid understanding of serverless architectures and AWS Lambda functions.
  • Experience designing and consuming RESTful and GraphQL APIs.
  • Knowledge of PostgreSQL, Redis, and background job frameworks (Sidekiq, Resque).
  • Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployments.
  • Experience working with Agile/Scrum methodologies, and proficiency using Jira and Confluence for project tracking.
  • Strong debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills for cross-functional collaboration.
  • Experience with microservices, GoLang, or Node.js for complementary service integration (nice to have).


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain Ruby on Rails applications with a focus on scalability and performance.
  • Build and manage AWS infrastructure components using Terraform and DevOps best practices.
  • Implement and maintain serverless solutions leveraging AWS Lambda and related services.
  • Integrate and maintain APIs and external systems, ensuring reliability and data consistency.
  • Refactor legacy components to improve maintainability, performance, and code clarity.
  • Write and maintain automated tests (RSpec, Minitest) to ensure high code quality and coverage.
  • Monitor application performance and proactively address issues or bottlenecks.
  • Collaborate on CI/CD pipelines, ensuring secure, consistent, and efficient deployments.
  • Participate in code reviews, maintaining high-quality development standards.
  • Engage in Agile ceremonies (standups, sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives).
  • Work closely with front-end, DevOps, and QA teams to deliver robust, end-to-end solutions.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

title: Power BI Developer
description:
Company Overview

Our client is a leading Project Portfolio Management (PPM) software company helping organizations deliver complex projects with speed and precision. As part of their growth, they seek a skilled Power BI Developer to join their product and engineering teams, driving our reporting and analytics capabilities to the next level.


Role Overview

You will be the primary Power BI authority, embedded within the product team and reporting directly to the Head of Product. Unlike legacy reporting roles, this position demands holistic thinking at the data model level, structuring interlinked datasets, and designing reports that deliver insight and impact. You will bring both technical rigor and visual finesse, turning raw data into compelling stories that support better decision-making.


Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain sophisticated Power BI dashboards and reports tailored to customer needs, reflecting strong narrative design principles.
  • Develop and manage embedded Power BI analytics solutions within our proprietary PPM software platform.
  • Architect and implement semantic data models in Power BI, integrating with Databricks and ensuring logical taxonomy for all datasets.
  • Write advanced PowerQuery scripts and DAX calculations for complex data transformation and analytics scenarios as needed.
  • Conduct thorough data QA, validating key metrics between our PPM platform, Databricks, and Power BI outputs.
  • Leverage SQL to extract, transform, and validate data. Understanding our integrations between Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), Azure Databricks, and Power BI.
  • Optimize dashboard performance with a deep understanding of Import mode vs. Direct Query trade‑offs.
  • Power BI workspace management, external user access, and governance best practices for secure reporting.
  • Collaborate in an Azure cloud environment with engineers and architects to ensure smooth data delivery pipelines.


Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Proven ability to blend technical data modeling expertise with sharp visual storytelling instincts.
  • Experience in PPM or project management software reporting environments.
  • Familiarity with Databricks Delta Sharing and cross‑organization data collaboration.
  • Success in working independently with minimal supervision in high‑autonomy roles.
  • Strong cross‑functional communication skills, fluent in English.
  • Previous experience collaborating with remote/offshore technical teams.


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands‑on experience with Power BI, including PowerQuery, DAX, and semantic modeling.
  • 2+ years of experience building Embedded Power BI Analytics solutions and managing advanced workspace functionality.
  • Proficient in SQL and comfortable moving data across cloud platforms (OCI, Databricks, Azure).
  • Demonstrated success in conducting data QA and optimizing report performance.
  • Solid understanding of Import mode, Direct Query, workspace management, and governance protocols in Power BI.

title: Instructional Designer
description:
Instructional Designer

Remote – Brazil | Contract | Full-Time


About the Role

Our client is looking for an Instructional Designer responsible for designing, developing, and delivering high-quality learning materials to support internal teams and partners. The focus will be on creating scalable, engaging learning experiences for product readiness, systems/process training, and ongoing enablement programs.

This role requires a self-sufficient professional with strong creative design capabilities and advanced proficiency in Articulate Storyline. The ideal candidate can quickly adapt, work independently, and collaborate effectively with subject matter experts and cross-functional stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop e-learning modules, videos, and other instructional content using Articulate Storyline and multimedia tools.
  • Manage multiple training projects, including systems/process training and product or solution readiness.
  • Collaborate with SMEs and internal teams to ensure content accuracy and alignment with business objectives.
  • Apply instructional design methodologies to ensure engaging and measurable learning outcomes.
  • Define content strategy and deliver final assets for publishing.
  • Track learner engagement and performance, using analytics and feedback to improve materials.
  • Stay up to date with instructional design trends and emerging technologies.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Instructional Design, Education, Communications, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in instructional design or enablement, preferably in complex or technical environments.
  • Advanced proficiency in Articulate Storyline (must be able to start with minimal onboarding).
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Strong creative and visual design abilities to translate complex topics into clear, learner-centered content.
  • Experience developing learning materials for internal teams, sales enablement, or process training initiatives.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with Learning Management Systems (LMS) and features such as branching, gamification, and assessments.
  • Certification in Instructional Design or Sales Enablement .

title: En español - Senior Full Stack Developer (TypeScript & Mobile)
description:
• Desarrollador/a Full Stack Senior (TypeScript y Mobile)
  • Remoto (preferencia zona horaria UTC-3 a UTC+2)
  • Jornada completa


Qué hacemos

Publica.la es una plataforma SaaS B2B utilizada por cientos de editoriales, librerías y bibliotecas en todo el mundo para vender y entregar contenido digital directamente a sus lectores.

Desarrollamos aplicaciones móviles y web con React Native y un núcleo compartido en TypeScript , que da servicio a miles de lectores diarios en iOS, Android y web .

Trabajarás principalmente en React Native y desarrollo frontend moderno, con oportunidades para contribuir en toda nuestra pila de TypeScript .

Qué harás
  • Desarrollar y lanzar funcionalidades de principio a fin para móvil y web: definir alcance, construir, probar, lanzar y aprender.
  • Crear aplicaciones sólidas en React Native y compartir modelos y lógica TypeScript con React y Vue .
  • Diseñar interfaces accesibles y rápidas utilizando Tailwind y patrones modernos de componentes.
  • Mantener alta calidad con tests y GitLab CI . Preferimos PRs pequeños y lanzamientos frecuentes.
  • Mejorar el rendimiento y la fiabilidad: tiempo de arranque, tamaño de bundle, modo offline, reintentos, manejo de errores.
  • Colaborar con los equipos de diseño, producto y soporte para convertir el feedback en mejoras.
  • Escribir documentación breve y clara, y proponer cambios pragmáticos cuando sea necesario.
  • Colaborar en servicios Laravel/PHP , SingleStore y Valkey/Redis cuando sea necesario.
  • Apoyar en infraestructura AWS o Cloudflare cuando corresponda.
Nuestro stack tecnológico

Principal: React Native, Electron, React, Vue, TypeScript, JavaScript, Tailwind, Node.js (scripting), GitLab CI, fastlane

También en otros proyectos: Laravel (PHP), SingleStore, Valkey/Redis, AWS, Cloudflare

Podrías encajar si tienes
  • Más de 6 años desarrollando interfaces de usuario , con al menos 3 años en React Native o una sólida experiencia en React con exposición a móvil.
  • Dominio de TypeScript y experiencia creando componentes y hooks reutilizables.
  • Experiencia lanzando y manteniendo aplicaciones en producción (móvil o web), con foco en la experiencia del usuario.
  • Sólidos fundamentos de CSS y diseño responsive. Experiencia con Tailwind es un plus.
  • Mentalidad orientada a testing: tests unitarios e integrados , Detox .
  • Comodidad trabajando con Git , revisiones de código y CI.
  • Nivel nativo o conversacional de español , y buena comunicación escrita en inglés y español (la mayoría de nuestra comunicación es asincrónica y escrita).
  • Portugués es un plus.
Deseable
  • Experiencia en rendimiento de React Native o desarrollo de módulos nativos (Hermes, JSI, animaciones).
  • Conocimientos de Laravel/PHP , SingleStore , Redis o desarrollo de interfaces con gran carga de datos.
  • Experiencia con AWS (Lambda, S3) y Cloudflare (Workers, CDN, cache).
  • Experiencia en observabilidad: Sentry , logs, métricas, feature flags, tests A/B simples.
Cómo trabajamos
  • Equipo pequeño, con preferencia por soluciones simples y lanzamientos frecuentes.
  • Comunicación asincrónica por defecto, con llamadas rápidas cuando es útil.
  • PRs con contexto claro y feedback ágil.
  • Valoramos la iniciativa : proponer, prototipar, medir, iterar.
Proceso de selección
  • Charla introductoria sobre tu experiencia y tus próximos objetivos.
  • Ejercicio práctico corto, basado en casos reales, que puedes realizar en tu tiempo libre.
  • Conversación técnica y revisión del ejercicio con un miembro del equipo.
  • Charla con nuestro CEO.
  • Oferta.
  • Acordamos una fecha de inicio y comenzamos a trabajar juntos.
Salario y beneficios
  • Salario competitivo en USD , según experiencia y ubicación.
  • Horarios y entorno de trabajo remoto flexibles .
  • Estructura laboral basada en resultados.
  • Entorno colaborativo, creativo y dinámico.
  • Oportunidad de trabajar en una plataforma e-commerce líder en la industria editorial .
  • Vacaciones ilimitadas.
  • Actividades de equipo ocasionales, 100% cubiertas por Publica.la.
  • Reembolso por libros adquiridos a través de nuestra plataforma.
Cómo postularte

Envíanos lo siguiente:

  • Tu CV / currículum
  • Enlaces a proyectos en los que hayas trabajado (perfil de GitHub, portafolio, etc.)
  • Tus expectativas salariales
  • Una breve nota sobre por qué quieres formar parte de Publica.la


Envía tu postulación a

con el asunto: Senior Full Stack Developer (TypeScript & Mobile)

description:
• Desarrollador/a Full Stack Senior (TypeScript y Mobile)
  • Remoto (preferencia zona horaria UTC-3 a UTC+2)
  • Jornada completa


Qué hacemos

Publica.la es una plataforma SaaS B2B utilizada por cientos de editoriales, librerías y bibliotecas en todo el mundo para vender y entregar contenido digital directamente a sus lectores.

Desarrollamos aplicaciones móviles y web con React Native y un núcleo compartido en TypeScript , que da servicio a miles de lectores diarios en iOS, Android y web .

Trabajarás principalmente en React Native y desarrollo frontend moderno, con oportunidades para contribuir en toda nuestra pila de TypeScript .

Qué harás
  • Desarrollar y lanzar funcionalidades de principio a fin para móvil y web: definir alcance, construir, probar, lanzar y aprender.
  • Crear aplicaciones sólidas en React Native y compartir modelos y lógica TypeScript con React y Vue .
  • Diseñar interfaces accesibles y rápidas utilizando Tailwind y patrones modernos de componentes.
  • Mantener alta calidad con tests y GitLab CI . Preferimos PRs pequeños y lanzamientos frecuentes.
  • Mejorar el rendimiento y la fiabilidad: tiempo de arranque, tamaño de bundle, modo offline, reintentos, manejo de errores.
  • Colaborar con los equipos de diseño, producto y soporte para convertir el feedback en mejoras.
  • Escribir documentación breve y clara, y proponer cambios pragmáticos cuando sea necesario.

Deseable
  • Experiencia en rendimiento de React Native o desarrollo de módulos nativos (Hermes, JSI, animaciones).

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
About You

You are a back-end engineer passionate about building scalable, reliable, and maintainable applications. You thrive on writing clean code, applying modern architecture patterns, and leveraging cloud-based solutions. You enjoy solving complex challenges, automating infrastructure, and ensuring that systems are secure, performant, and ready to scale. You’re looking for a company where you can keep growing professionally and directly influence technical excellence.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field; or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in back-end development using Ruby on Rails.
  • Strong experience with AWS services such as Lambda, EC2, S3, RDS, and API Gateway.
  • Hands-on experience using Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC) deployments.
  • Solid understanding of serverless architectures and AWS Lambda functions.
  • Experience designing and consuming RESTful and GraphQL APIs.
  • Knowledge of PostgreSQL, Redis, and background job frameworks (Sidekiq, Resque).
  • Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployments.
  • Experience working with Agile/Scrum methodologies, and proficiency using Jira and Confluence for project tracking.
  • Strong debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills for cross-functional collaboration.
  • Experience with microservices, GoLang, or Node.js for complementary service integration (nice to have).


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain Ruby on Rails applications with a focus on scalability and performance.
  • Build and manage AWS infrastructure components using Terraform and DevOps best practices.
  • Implement and maintain serverless solutions leveraging AWS Lambda and related services.
  • Integrate and maintain APIs and external systems, ensuring reliability and data consistency.
  • Refactor legacy components to improve maintainability, performance, and code clarity.
  • Write and maintain automated tests (RSpec, Minitest) to ensure high code quality and coverage.
  • Monitor application performance and proactively address issues or bottlenecks.
  • Collaborate on CI/CD pipelines, ensuring secure, consistent, and efficient deployments.
  • Participate in code reviews, maintaining high-quality development standards.
  • Engage in Agile ceremonies (standups, sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives).
  • Work closely with front-end, DevOps, and QA teams to deliver robust, end-to-end solutions.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

description:

A G4F é uma empresa com uma trajetória sólida de 15 anos, dedicada a conectar pessoas, ideias e tecnologia para oferecer soluções inovadoras. Somos mais de 8.000 #greaters atuando em todo o Brasil.


Requisitos:

Experiência exercendo atividades como arquiteto de aplicações Java EE 6+.

Experiência no desenvolvimento de aplicações para pelo menos um

dos servidores:

· Apache Tomcat;

· JBoss/Wildfly;

· Open Liberty;

· WebSphere Application Server Liberty;

Certificação CSD - Certified Scrum Developer.

Experiência em análise e tunning de performance de aplicações em servidores WebSphere Application Server.

Experiência no desenvolvimento de aplicações que utilizem portlets, JSF (Primefaces) ou React.

Experiência no uso das seguintes ferramentas: IBM Integration Bus, IBM Websphere MQ, Apache Maven e Gradle.

title: Architectural Designer (Level 2) - Revit/BIM Focused
description:
Architectural Designer (Level 2) — Revit/BIM Focused

Remote (Full-Time)


We’re a values-driven architecture studio based in Toronto, focused on heritage conservation , adaptive reuse , and resilient residential design . We believe in reimagining, not replacing , and in crafting design solutions that are bold, enduring, and rooted in context.

Our team is small, nimble, and growing fast. We work collaboratively across time zones and use technology to stay sharp, fast, and deeply engaged.


The Role

We’re hiring a Level 2 Architectural Designer who thrives in Revit and is comfortable working from design development through to construction drawings . You’ll take ownership of key project components, work directly with senior staff and clients, and bring care and clarity to every detail you produce.

This is a remote, full-time role with flexible hours — but we work fast, and we expect a high level of autonomy, precision, and initiative.


What You’ll Do
  • Develop architectural designs in Revit across all project phases
  • Produce clear, coordinated construction drawings and documentation
  • Collaborate with team members across time zones in a highly visual workflow
  • Participate in detailing, specifications, and code coordination
  • Help integrate sustainability and reuse strategies into our drawings
  • Occasionally support site coordination and permit application packages


You Are:
  • 5+ years into your architecture career
  • Advanced in Revit (we mean fluent — not just functional)
  • Deeply organized, proactive, and detail-oriented
  • Comfortable juggling two projects at once
  • Great at communicating visually and in writing (English required)
  • Experienced with construction documents (Canadian or European context preferred)
  • Bonus: experience in adaptive reuse, heritage projects, or energy retrofits
  • Bonus: skilled in Lumion


Qualifications:
  • Bachelor or Master’s degree in Architecture
  • Licensed or on the path to licensure
  • Portfolio that shows strong design thinking and technical precision
  • Legally eligible to work as an independent contractor


Why Join Boldera?

We’re building something rare — a studio that blends design excellence, social purpose, and startup energy . You’ll be part of a close-knit team that punches above its weight, values clarity and curiosity, and works on projects that matter.

title: Casting Coordinator
description:
As Blueclip, we started our journey to bring the most creative minds and the know-how together to deliver great works.


About Our Search

We are currently looking for a Casting Coordinator to join our client, a global content company with a focus on talent sourcing for dynamic content projects.


What are we looking for?

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience.
  • 2+ years of experience in casting, story production, or talent interviewing.
  • Strong communication skills in English.
  • Proficiency with various casting resources and familiarity with social media platforms like TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and Twitch.
  • High attention to detail and the ability to work efficiently under tight deadlines.
  • Organized, self-motivated, and capable of handling multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Positive attitude with flexibility to adapt to last-minute changes and cancellations.
  • Experience with casting databases and familiarity with Monday.com and Google Suite.


What will you do?

This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to talent sourcing and casting across innovative content projects.


  • Identify and source emerging talent across social media platforms, staying on top of trends.
  • Post-casting calls aligned with creative outlines for new and ongoing productions.
  • Screen, organize, and categorize auditions, preparing submissions for producer review.
  • Coordinate auditions with talent, agencies, and managers, managing the talent booking process.
  • Maintain a robust casting database with accurate records and updated talent profiles.
  • Collaborate with Performance Managers to validate profiles, negotiate terms, and align schedules.
  • Produce and direct assigned content episodes, ensuring alignment with strategy, budget, and creative goals.
  • Hosting the episodes on Youtube, being on camera as an interviewer.
  • Build strong relationships with the talent to foster positive creative collaborations and ensure smooth productions.
  • Track deadlines, legal requirements, and production specifications for timely and cost-effective delivery.


Are you ready to make an impact in content creation? Apply now with your English CV !

  • High attention to detail and the ability to work efficiently under tight deadlines.
  • Organized, self-motivated, and capable of handling multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Positive attitude with flexibility to adapt to last-minute changes and cancellations.
  • Experience with casting databases and familiarity with Monday.com and Google Suite.


What will you do?

This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to talent sourcing and casting across innovative content projects.


  • Identify and source emerging talent across social media platforms, staying on top of trends.
  • Post-casting calls aligned with creative outlines for new and ongoing productions.
  • Screen, organize, and categorize auditions, preparing submissions for producer review.
  • Coordinate auditions with talent, agencies, and managers, managing the talent booking process.
  • Maintain a robust casting database with accurate records and updated talent profiles.
  • Collaborate with Performance Managers to validate profiles, negotiate terms, and align schedules.
  • Produce and direct assigned content episodes, ensuring alignment with strategy, budget, and creative goals.
  • Hosting the episodes on Youtube, being on camera as an interviewer.
  • Build strong relationships with the talent to foster positive creative collaborations and ensure smooth productions.
  • Track deadlines, legal requirements, and production specifications for timely and cost-effective delivery.


Are you ready to make an impact in content creation? Apply now with your English CV !

title: Senior Compliance Specialist
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Job Description : The Compliance Officer ensures that the organization adheres to all applicable laws and regulations, particularly with respect to anti-money laundering (AML) and other financial crimes prevention standards. This role is critical in mitigating the risks associated with non-compliance and ensuring that the crypto exchange maintains a strong reputation.


Key Responsibilities :

  • Develop and implement the company’s compliance program, ensuring adherence to regulations.
  • Monitor changes in regulatory and legal requirements affecting the business.
  • Oversee the preparation of regulatory reports and filings.
  • Conduct internal compliance audits and assessments.
  • Educate employees on compliance standards and best practices.
  • Report non-compliance issues to senior management and regulatory bodies.


Requirements :

  • At least 5 years of experience in compliance, particularly in financial institutions or crypto exchanges.
  • An undergraduate degree in law, finance, or a related field.
  • Knowledge of anti-money laundering (AML) regulations and risk management.
  • Ability to effectively communicate compliance requirements to various stakeholders.
  • Residents of Argentina or Brazil


Why Join Us

At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.

Our benefits include:

  • Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
  • Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
  • Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
  • Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
  • Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

title: Consultor em contabilidade bancária/regulamentação prudencial
description:
Oportunidade para construir o futuro do mercado financeiro e contabilidade no Brasil! Vaga full time, CLT, para trabalho remoto, com compromissos eventuais na cidade de São Paulo.

Buscamos uma consultora júnior ou pleno com comprometimento, vontade de aprender e de compartilhar conhecimento. Esta vaga faz parte do nosso compromisso com a diversidade e a inclusão, com foco na ampliação da representatividade feminina na equipe


Responsabilidades:

·        Condução de reuniões e apresentações para clientes;

·        Conduzir projetos de consultoria em contabilidade IFRS/BACEN;

·        Participar de pareceres e notas técnicas sobre temas contábeis IFRS e BACENGAAP;

·        Redigir textos técnicos para plataforma de conteúdo.

·        Conhecimento em normas contábeis IFRS e BACEN;

·        Conhecimento de pacote office (Power Point; Excel; entre outros);

·        Formação acadêmica compatível (Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou Administração). 

Envie seu currículo e vamos conversar!

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Judi is a U.S.-based healthcare technology company that provides pharmacy benefit management (PBM) services. Their focus is on making prescription drug pricing more transparent and affordable for employers, health plans, and patients.

Join our mission to transform our nation’s healthcare system as a Senior Full-stack Software Developer. In this role, you will assist in leading projects from design to delivery. Partner with product managers and designers to define requirements during discovery and planning. Collaborate with developers to deliver those requirements on time as new features or improvements to existing functionality.


Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • We have a remote-first culture.
  • You will make a tangible impact on society. Your code will directly improve healthcare experiences for millions.
  • We are a late-stage startup with stability. We have startup energy with a focus on delivery, but healthy processes with a strong financial outlook that provides a sense of security.


Position Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll combine technical leadership with hands-on coding to build scalable, high-impact healthcare technology. You will:

  • Exercise leadership over features from design to delivery.
  • Be a partner to product, design, and quality assurance team members.
  • Become a subject matter expert on your team’s products.
  • Provide technical support to cross-functional team members and stakeholders.
  • Expand Judi, our web-based enterprise health platform, using Python, AWS services, React/Typescript, and other technologies.
  • Work in an Agile/Scrum environment.


Preferred Qualifications

We’re looking for someone who brings a mix of technical expertise, problem-solving ability, and collaborative spirit:

  • 7+ years of job-related experience.
  • Desire to work at a health tech company.
  • Strong Python (Flask / SQLAlchemy) and React / Typescript experience.
  • Advanced PostgreSQL database knowledge (e.g., common table expressions, windowing functions, views, stored procedures, full-text or geospatial indexing).
  • Experience with infrastructure as code using AWS, Terraform, or similar technologies.
  • Experience writing unit and integration tests.
  • Git expertise and experience working in a mono repo.
  • Able to demonstrate agency, urgency, and ownership over delivering quality work.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Previous Pharmacy Benefits Manager (PBM) experience is a plus.


What You Get:

  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team;
  • Unlimited PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule;
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences;
  • Health/Sport budget
  • Remote work.


This position description is designed to be flexible, allowing management the opportunity to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities as needed to best meet organizational goals.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer - AI Productivity Platform (Remote)
description:
Senior Full-Stack Engineer - AI Productivity Platform (Remote)


About Us


We're a small AI startup revolutionizing how professionals work by building cutting-edge productivity solutions that enterprises trust. Our platform serves Fortune 500 companies and scaling businesses that demand reliability, security, and innovation.

The Role

We're seeking a skilled Full-Stack Engineer to join our team in building an enterprise-grade productivity platform for researchers and engineers. You'll work directly on production systems that power critical workflows for major enterprises.

Key Responsibilities
  • Build and deploy Next.js applications integrated with AWS services
  • Deploy Python backend services to AWS for production environments
  • Develop user and data management features across the full stack
  • Implement SOC 2 compliance requirements and security best practices
  • Work with RAG systems and LLM integrations to deliver AI-powered features
  • Collaborate on architecture decisions that scale to enterprise demands
Technical Requirements
  • Minimum 5 years of professional software engineering experience in production environments
  • Strong experience with Next.js and modern React patterns
  • Proficiency in Python backend development
  • Hands-on experience with AWS services (Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, CloudFormation, OpenSearch, etc.)
  • Familiarity with Docker builds
  • Understanding of vector databases and RAG architectures
  • Experience with production deployments and CI/CD pipelines
  • Knowledge of security best practices and compliance frameworks (SOC 2 preferred)
Tech Stack

Next.js | Vercel | Python | AWS | Docker | Vector DBs | LLMs 

What We Offer
  • Competitive Compensation: R$ 320,000 annually with clear path to R$ 500,000 after 8 months (based on company milestones)
  • Flexible Remote Work: Work from anywhere with quarterly in-person team gatherings
  • Cutting-Edge Technology: Direct work with production AI systems and latest LLM technologies
  • High Impact: Shape core product features used by Fortune 500 companies
  • Growth Opportunities: Professional development budget and learning opportunities
Ready to Build the Future of Work?

Join us in creating AI solutions that transform how enterprises operate. This is an opportunity to work on meaningful problems with immediate real-world impact.

title: Assistente administrativo e comércio exterior
description:
Objetivo da posição

Dar suporte às operações de comércio exterior e à área comercial internacional, garantindo a organização administrativa, o acompanhamento dos processos e o apoio à prospecção de clientes, contribuindo para a expansão global da empresa.


Quem Somos? 


Aqui na Business For All, negociamos com o mundo inteiro, porém não negociamos nossos valores. Aqui valorizamos a diversidade, respeitamos as pessoas e as histórias verdadeiras.

Somos uma aceleradora global que conecta marcas brasileiras ao mundo, uma startup que nasce com muito conhecimento técnico, confiança e carteira de clientes potentes.

Já levamos grandes empresas a novos mercados e seguimos abrindo caminhos para que o Brasil brilhe lá fora.

Nossos valores inegociáveis: VERDADE, ÉTICA e RESPONSABILIDADE

Se você tem sede de conhecimento e quer contribuir para levar mais Brasil ao mundo , junte-se a nós.



Candidate-se e venha crescer em um ambiente dinâmico, inovador e global!


Principais responsabilidades

  • Atividades Administrativas e Organização
  • Organização de pastas e documentos no Google Drive.
  • Controle e atualização de planilhas de leads, clientes e prospecções.
  • Apoio na gestão de agendas e no agendamento de reuniões nacionais e internacionais.
  • Cadastro da empresa em feiras, rodadas de negócios e programas de internacionalização.
  • Suporte a Vendas e Prospecção
  • Apoio na organização e atualização da lista de leads.
  • Auxílio no contato inicial com potenciais clientes e parceiros (follow-up).
  • Acompanhamento de pedidos e apoio ao time de expansão de negócios.
  • Auxílio na preparação de materiais comerciais (apresentações, propostas e relatórios).
  • Operacional de Comércio Exterior
  • Emissão de Proforma Invoice.
  • Apoio nos processos de faturamento e conferência de documentos.
  • Suporte ao agenciamento e acompanhamento de pedidos internacionais.
  • Interface com fornecedores, clientes e parceiros logísticos quando necessário.


✅ Requisitos

  • Formação em andamento ou concluída em Comércio Exterior, Administração, Relações Internacionais ou áreas correlatas.
  • Boa organização e atenção a detalhes.
  • Conhecimentos básicos em rotinas de exportação e documentos comerciais (proforma, invoice, packing list) pode ser um diferencial
  • Pacote Office / Google Workspace (Excel/Sheets, Word/Docs, PowerPoint/Slides).
  • Gostar de inglês e espanhol (você não precisa saber, mas gostar, ter vontade de aprender)
  • Interesse em IA


⭐ Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia em ambiente dinâmico
  • Vontade de aprender espanhol e coisas novas
  • Interesse em carreira de comércio exterior.


O que oferecemos

  • Remuneração R$ 1.700,00/mês
  • Ambiente dinâmico e em constante crescimento.
  • Trilha de aprendizagem e desenvolvimento contínuo.
  • Vaga 100% remota (trabalho de qualquer lugar).
  • Regime de contratação PJ – contratação por 6 meses + renovação conforme alinhamento entre as partes
  • Horário para atuação: 30 horas semanais
  • Após 90 dias de experiência, oferecemos curso de inglês para você aprender no seu tempo
